title: AutoSP: Unlocking Long-Context LLM Training Via Compiler-Based Sequence Parallelism
summary: Large-language-models (LLMs) demonstrate enormous utility in long-context tasks which require processing prompts that consist of tens to hundreds of thousands of tokens. However, existing LLM training libraries do not provide easy to use abstractions to optimize for long-context training, instead focusing on optimizations for models with large parameter counts through ZeRO-3/FSDP, Tensor and Pipeline parallelism. This forces users to rewrite LLM training libraries to incorporate compositions of various complex long-context optimizations, such as sequence-parallelism, to training pipelines; a process that requires in-depth expertise, reducing developer productivity. To tackle these challenges, we introduce AutoSP: the first automated solution to automatically optimize LLM training for longer-contexts. AutoSP compiles models and applies a targeted set of optimizations: automated sequence parallelism, and long-context aware activation-checkpointing, to drastically enhance LLM trainability at negligible cost to throughput. Our evaluation demonstrates AutoSP's capability on both NVIDIA and AMD hardware, increasing training contexts by upto 2.7$\times$ and 2.5$\times$ respectively over competitive hand-written baseline at negligible cost to runtime performance.

title: End-to-end autonomous scientific discovery on a real optical platform
summary: Scientific research has long been human-led, driving new knowledge and transformative technologies through the continual revision of questions, methods and claims as evidence accumulates. Although large language model (LLM)-based agents are beginning to move beyond assisting predefined research workflows, none has yet demonstrated end-to-end autonomous discovery in a real physical system that produces a nontrivial result supported by experimental evidence. Here we introduce Qiushi Discovery Engine, an LLM-based agentic system for end-to-end autonomous scientific discovery on a real optical platform. Qiushi Engine combines nonlinear research phases, Meta-Trace memory and a dual-layer architecture to maintain adaptive and stable research trajectories across long-horizon investigations involving thousands of LLM-mediated reasoning, measurement and revision actions. It autonomously reproduces a published transmission-matrix experiment on a non-original platform and converts an abstract coherence-order theory into experimental observables, providing, to our knowledge, the first observation of this class of coherence-order structure. More importantly, in an open-ended study involving 145.9 million tokens, 3,242 LLM calls, 1,242 tool calls, 163 research notes and 44 scripts, Qiushi Engine proposes and experimentally validates optical bilinear interaction, a physical mechanism structurally analogous to a core operation in Transformer attention. This AI-discovered mechanism suggests a route towards high-speed, energy-efficient optical hardware for pairwise computation. To our knowledge, this is the first demonstration of an AI agentic system autonomously identifying and experimentally validating a nontrivial, previously unreported physical mechanism, marking a milestone for research-level autonomous agents.

title: Useless but Safe? Benchmarking Utility Recovery with User Intent Clarification in Multi-Turn Conversations
summary: Current LLM safety alignment techniques improve model robustness against adversarial attacks, but overlook whether and how LLMs can recover helpfulness when benign users clarify their intent. We introduce CarryOnBench, the first interactive benchmark that measures whether LLMs can revise their interpretation of user intent and recover utility, while remaining safe through multi-turn conversations. Starting from 398 seemingly harmful queries with benign underlying intents, we simulate 5,970 conversations by varying user follow-up sequences, evaluating 14 models on both intent-aligned utility and safety. CarryOnBench yields 1,866 different conversation flows of 4--12 turns, totaling 23,880 model responses. We design Ben-Util, a checklist-based metric that evaluates how well each model response fulfills the user's benign information need using atomic items. At turn one, models fulfill only 10.5--37.6% of the user's benign information need. When the same query includes the benign intent upfront, models fulfill 25.1--72.1%, confirming that models withhold information due to intent misinterpretation, not limited knowledge. With benign clarifications in multi-turn conversations, 13 of 14 models approach or exceed this single-turn baseline, yet recovery cost varies across models. We identify three failure modes invisible to single-turn evaluations: utility lock-in, where a model rarely updates despite clarification; unsafe recovery, where a model updates at disproportionate safety cost; and repetitive recovery, where a model recycles prior responses rather than providing new information. Moreover, conversations converge to similar harmfulness levels regardless of how conservative the model starts. These findings expose a gap that single-turn evaluations miss -- whether a model is appropriately cautious or simply unresponsive to clarified user intent.

title: Interaction Forces and Internal Loads in Parallel Manipulators with Actuation Redundancy
comments: 13 pages, 11 figures. Submitted to Mechanism and Machine Theory
summary: This paper discusses null-space wrench components in parallel manipulators. We examine the adaptation of the two most common characterizations of these components in grasp-like systems, namely, interaction forces and internal loads, to parallel manipulators with actuation redundancy. We identify critical oversights in the existing literature on the subject, resolve ambiguities related to the definitions of interaction forces and internal loads, and provide explicit methods for synthesizing equilibrating and manipulating joint torque vectors. A case study is also provided to justify the validity of our novel methods and correct erroneous results reported in the literature.
comment: 13 pages, 11 figures. Submitted to Mechanism and Machine Theory

title: Think it, Run it: Autonomous ML pipeline generation via self-healing multi-agent AI
summary: The purpose of our paper is to develop a unified multi-agent architecture that automates end-to-end machine learning (ML) pipeline generation from datasets and natural-language (NL) goals, improving efficiency, robustness and explainability. A five-agent system is proposed to handle profiling, intent parsing, microservice recommendation, Directed Acyclic Graph (DAG) construction and execution. It integrates code-grounded Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) for microservice understanding, an explainable hybrid recommender combining multiple criteria, a self-healing mechanism using Large Language Model (LLM)-based error interpretation and adaptive learning from execution history. The approach is evaluated on 150 ML tasks across diverse scenarios. The system achieves an 84.7% end-to-end pipeline success rate, outperforming baseline methods. It demonstrates improved robustness through self-healing and reduces workflow development time compared to manual construction. The study introduces a novel integration of code-grounded RAG, explainable recommendation, self-healing execution and adaptive learning within a single architecture, showing that tightly coupled intelligent components can outperform isolated solutions.

title: Anomaly Detection in Soil Heavy Metal Contamination Using Unsupervised Learning for Environmental Risk Assessment
summary: Soil contamination by heavy metals poses a persistent environmental and public health concern in rapidly urbanising regions of Ghana, particularly at unregulated waste disposal sites. This study applies an unsupervised machine learning framework to detect and characterise anomalous heavy metal contamination patterns in soils from twelve waste sites and residential controls in the Central Region, of Ghana. Concentrations of eight metals (As, Cd, Cr, Cu, Hg, Ni, Pb, Zn) were analysed alongside standard health risk indices, including the Hazard Index (HI) and Incremental Lifetime Cancer Risk (ILCR). Isolation Forest and PCA reconstruction error each identified $12$ anomalous samples ($15.4\%$ of $78$ samples), while DBSCAN detected no density-isolated noise points. A consensus approach isolated six robust anomalies ($7.7\%)$, all spatially concentrated at a single site (S3). Anomalies exhibited approximately $70$--$80\%$ higher mean HI values than normal samples, with all consensus anomalies exceeding the HI$=1$ threshold. PCA reconstruction error showed a strong positive association with HI ($r \approx 0.8$), indicating consistency between multivariate deviation and health risk. Three distinct anomaly types were identified: extreme Cu enrichment at S3, anomalously low Ni at S4/S5, and moderate multi-metal (Pb--Zn) co-elevation at S9--S12. The results demonstrate that unsupervised machine learning provides granular, objective insight beyond aggregate indices, enabling targeted site prioritisation and risk-informed environmental management.

title: Low-Complexity Run-Length-Limited ISI-Mitigation (RLIM) Codes for Molecular Communication
summary: Molecular communication suffers from severe inter-symbol interference, which makes constrained coding essential for reliable transmission. Run-length-limited ISI-mitigation codes are attractive because they select low-weight constrained codebooks, reducing ISI while allowing more molecules to be assigned to each transmitted 1-symbol under the usual molecular-communication normalization. Previous results showed strong bit-error-rate performance for these codes, but their original realization required full codebook generation and storage. This exponential storage growth is unsuitable for resource-constrained molecular communication channels and also limits the exploration of larger information dimensions. This is particularly important for nano-scale molecular communication, where transmitter and receiver nodes are expected to operate under severe memory and computational constraints. This paper removes that realization bottleneck by replacing full codebook storage with an enumerative realization based on Cover's ranking framework, constant-weight run-length-limited counting, and cumulative weight-layer offsets. The resulting encoder and decoder preserve the selected RLIM codebooks and the original projection-based decoding behavior while storing only polynomial-size counting tables. Storage and runtime measurements confirm the resulting exponential-to-polynomial reduction, and diffusion-based molecular-communication simulations show that the newly accessible larger-dimensional RLIM regimes can improve the best attainable bit-error-rate performance in the tested settings.

title: Automated Detection of Mutual Gaze and Joint Attention in Dual-Camera Settings via Dual-Stream Transformers
summary: Analyzing mutual gaze (MG) and joint attention (JA) is critical in developmental psychology but traditionally relies on labor-intensive manual coding. Automating this process in multi-camera laboratory settings is computationally challenging due to complex cross-camera relational dynamics. In this paper, we propose a highly efficient dual-stream Transformer architecture for detecting MG and JA from synchronized dual-camera recordings. Our approach leverages frozen gaze-aware backbones (GazeLLE) to extract rich visual priors, combined with a custom token fusion mechanism to map the spatial and semantic relationships between interacting dyads. Evaluated on an ecologically valid dataset of caregiver-infant interactions, our model exhibits good performance, significantly outperforming both a convolutional baseline and a state-of-the-art multimodal Large Language Model (LLM). By open-sourcing our model and pre-trained weights, we provide behavioral scientists with a scalable tool that can be fine-tuned to diverse laboratory environments, effectively bridging the gap between computational modeling and applied interaction research.

title: Reconstruction by Generation: 3D Multi-Object Scene Reconstruction from Sparse Observations
summary: Accurately reconstructing complex full multi-object scenes from sparse observations remains a core challenge in computer vision and a key step toward scalable and reliable simulation for robotics. In this work, we introduce RecGen, a generative framework for probabilistic joint estimation of object and part shapes, as well as their pose under occlusion and partial visibility from one or multiple RGB-D images. By leveraging compositional synthetic scene generation and strong 3D shape priors, RecGen generalizes across diverse object types and real-world environments. RecGen achieves state-of-the-art performance on complex, heavily occluded datasets, robustly handling severe occlusions, symmetric objects, object parts, and intricate geometry and texture. Despite using nearly 80% fewer training meshes than the previous state of the art SAM3D, RecGen outperforms it by 30.1% in geometric shape quality, 9.1% in texture reconstruction, and 33.9% in pose estimation.

title: On the Effectiveness of Modular Testing with EvoSuite
summary: This paper explores the effectiveness of modular randomized testing for object oriented programs in Java. Modular testing involves testing individual components of a program in isolation. Often times, for effective test generation, a series of non-target setup calls must be included to obtain high coverage of the target component. In this work, we evaluate and improve modular testing with the EvoSuite test generator. We find that due to strict restrictions that disallow calls to non-target setup methods, EvoSuite's modular testing mode is ineffective and often results in low branch coverage. We propose \textsc{emote} (Effective Modular Testing with EvoSuite): an enhancement to EvoSuite that relaxes this restriction, allowing non-target methods to be included in the test prefixes. This modification draws inspiration from developer-written fuzz drivers, which often invoke setup methods to properly initialize the state before testing the target method. To ensure meaningful test generation, we modify EvoSuite's fitness function to focus branch coverage contributions on the call chain originating from the target method. \textsc{emote} is evaluated on a subset of the SF100 benchmark, showing a 15.15\% improvement in coverage of the target methods.

title: Exploring the Limits of Pruning: Task-Specific Neurons, Model Collapse, and Recovery in Task-Specific Large Language Models
summary: Neuron pruning is widely used to reduce the computational cost and parameter footprint of large language models, yet it remains unclear whether neurons in task-specific models contribute uniformly to task performance. In this work, we provide empirical evidence for the existence and importance of task-specific neurons through a systematic pruning study on language models specialized for mathematical reasoning and code generation. We introduce an activation-based selectivity metric to identify neurons with low contribution to the target task and prune them while preserving target-task accuracy, and compare selective pruning with random pruning. Selective pruning consistently outperforms random pruning, indicating that activation-based selectivity provides a systematic advantage over random pruning. Reverse pruning experiments further show that removing a small subset of highly task-specific neurons (~10%) causes complete performance collapse, suggesting that there exist task specific neurons and critical task information is concentrated in a small portion of the network. In contrast, selective pruning of less critical neurons (~30% - ~35%) reduces accuracy but still preserves significant performance. We also observed consistent reductions in parameters and runtime VRAM usage, along with improved inference throughput as pruning increases. Experiments on both 1.5B and 7B models reveal a robustness threshold around 15-20% pruning, beyond which accuracy loss and generation failures increase sharply. Fine-tuning substantially recovers performance across pruning levels, particularly for aggressively pruned models. These findings provide empirical evidence of neuron specialization in task-specific language models and offer insights into pruning robustness, model redundancy, and post-pruning recoverability.

title: A Gated Hybrid Contrastive Collaborative Filtering Recommendation
summary: Recommender systems increasingly incorporate textual reviews to enrich user and item representations. However, most review-aware models remain optimized for rating prediction rather than ranking quality. This misalignment limits their effectiveness in top-N recommendation scenarios, where discriminative ranking is essential. To address this gap, we propose a Gated Hybrid Collaborative Filtering framework that integrates review-derived representations into an autoencoder-based collaborative model. The architecture injects semantic signals layer-wise through an adaptive gating mechanism that dynamically balances collaborative embeddings and topic-based features during encoding. To further refine the latent space, we introduce a contrastive learning module that aligns semantic and collaborative signals. We evaluate the framework across five distinct configurations: Pure collaborative; Topic and Gated; Text and Gated; and the addition of contrastive objectives (Contrastive and Topic, and Contrastive and Text). To explicitly optimize ranking behavior, the model is trained with a pairwise Bayesian personalized ranking objective, which promotes separation between relevant and non-relevant items in the latent space. Experiments on Amazon Movies & TV, IMDb, and Rotten Tomatoes demonstrate consistent improvements in hit rate @10 and normalized discounted cumulative gain @10 over state-of-the-art review-aware baselines. Results highlight the importance of controlled semantic fusion for ranking-driven recommendation.

title: PALCAS: A Priority-Aware Intelligent Lane Change Advisory System for Autonomous Vehicles using Federated Reinforcement Learning
summary: We present a priority-aware intelligent lane change advisory system based on multi-agent federated reinforcement learning, namely PALCAS, for autonomous vehicles (AVs). While existing lane-change approaches typically focus on single-agent systems or centralized multi-agent systems, we introduce a federated reinforcement learning-based multi-agent lane change system prioritizing lane changing based on vehicle destination urgency. PALCAS incorporates a novel priority-aware safe lane-change reward function to enable judicious lane-change decisions in both mandatory and discretionary scenarios. PALCAS leverages the parameterized deep Q-network (PDQN) algorithm to facilitate effective cooperation among agents, enabling both lateral and longitudinal motion controls of AVs. Extensive simulations conducted using the SUMO traffic simulator and Mosaic V2X communication framework demonstrate that PALCAS significantly improves traffic efficiency, driving safety, comfort, destination arrival rates, and merging success rates compared to baseline methods.

AI.title_translation: PALCAS：一种基于联邦强化学习的自动驾驶汽车优先感知智能变道咨询系统
AI.tldr: PALCAS是一个基于多智能体联邦强化学习的自动驾驶变道系统，它通过考虑目的地紧急程度和安全奖励函数，在模拟中显著提高了交通效率、安全性、舒适度、到达率和并道成功率。
AI.motivation: 现有变道方法通常关注单智能体系统或集中式多智能体系统，缺乏对车辆目的地紧急程度的优先感知。
AI.method: 本文提出PALCAS系统，这是一个基于多智能体联邦强化学习的变道咨询系统，其特点是根据车辆目的地紧急程度优先进行变道。PALCAS包含一个新颖的优先感知安全变道奖励函数，以实现强制性和自由裁量场景中的明智变道决策。该系统利用参数化深度Q网络（PDQN）算法促进智能体间的有效协作，从而实现自动驾驶汽车的横向和纵向运动控制。
AI.result: 通过SUMO交通模拟器和Mosaic V2X通信框架进行的广泛模拟表明，与基线方法相比，PALCAS显著提高了交通效率、驾驶安全性、舒适度、目的地到达率和并道成功率。
AI.conclusion: PALCAS通过联邦强化学习和优先级感知机制，有效提升了自动驾驶汽车在变道决策中的性能，在多项关键指标上超越了现有方法。
AI.translation: 我们提出了一种面向自动驾驶汽车（AVs）的、基于多智能体联邦强化学习的优先感知智能变道咨询系统，即PALCAS。现有变道方法通常侧重于单智能体系统或集中式多智能体系统，而我们引入了一种基于联邦强化学习的多智能体变道系统，该系统根据车辆目的地紧急程度优先进行变道。PALCAS融合了一种新颖的优先感知安全变道奖励函数，以在强制性和自由裁量场景中实现明智的变道决策。PALCAS利用参数化深度Q网络（PDQN）算法促进智能体之间的有效合作，从而实现自动驾驶汽车的横向和纵向运动控制。使用SUMO交通模拟器和Mosaic V2X通信框架进行的广泛模拟表明，与基线方法相比，PALCAS显著提高了交通效率、驾驶安全性、舒适度、目的地到达率和并道成功率。
AI.summary: 本文介绍了一种名为PALCAS的自动驾驶汽车智能变道咨询系统，该系统基于多智能体联邦强化学习，并引入了对车辆目的地紧急程度的优先级感知。PALCAS设计了新的优先感知安全变道奖励函数，并采用PDQN算法实现智能体协作，以控制车辆的横向和纵向运动。模拟结果显示，PALCAS在交通效率、安全性、舒适度、到达率和并道成功率方面均优于现有方法。
AI.keywords: 联邦强化学习, 自动驾驶汽车, 变道系统, 优先级感知, 多智能体系统
AI.comments: PALCAS的创新之处在于将联邦强化学习与优先级感知机制相结合，解决了传统单智能体或集中式多智能体变道系统在处理复杂交通和紧急情况下的局限性。其提出的优先感知安全奖励函数和PDQN算法的应用，有效提升了自动驾驶汽车的变道决策质量和整体交通流畅性。

title: InterPartAbility: Text-Guided Part Matching for Interpretable Person Re-Identification
summary: Text-to-image person re-identification (TI-ReID) relies on natural-language text description to retrieve top matching individuals from a large gallery of images. While recent large vision-language models (VLMs) achieve strong retrieval performance, their decisions remain largely uninterpretable. Existing interpretability approaches in TI-ReID rely solely on slot-attention to highlight attended regions, but fail to reliably bind visual regions to semantically meaningful concepts, limiting explanations to qualitative visualizations over a restricted vocabulary. This paper introduces InterPartAbility, an interpretable TI-ReID method that performs explicit part-wise matching and enables phrase-region grounding. A new open-vocabulary, lightweight supervision, patch-phrase interaction module (PPIM) is proposed to train a standard TI-ReID model with concept-level guidance. Concept-based part phrases provide evidence that encourages the model to attend to corresponding image regions. InterPartAbility further constrains CLIP ViT self-attention to produce spatially concentrated patch activations aligned with each part-level phrase, yielding grounded explanation maps. A quantitative interpretability protocol for TI-ReID is introduced by adapting perturbation-based evaluation metrics, including counterfactual region masking that measures retrieval degradation when top-ranked explanatory regions are removed. Empirical results\footnote{Our code is included in the supplementary materials and will be made public.} on challenging benchmarks like CUHK-PEDES and ICFG-PEDES show that InterPartAbility achieves state-of-the-art (SOTA) interpretability performance under these metrics, while sustaining competitive retrieval accuracy.

AI.title_translation: InterPartAbility：文本引导的部件匹配用于可解释行人重识别
AI.tldr: InterPartAbility是一种可解释的文本到图像行人重识别方法，通过显式部件匹配和短语-区域接地，实现了最先进的可解释性并保持了竞争力检索精度。
AI.motivation: 现有的文本到图像行人重识别（TI-ReID）模型，尤其是大型视觉语言模型（VLMs），虽然检索性能强大，但其决策过程缺乏可解释性。现有的可解释性方法无法可靠地将视觉区域绑定到语义概念，限制了解释能力。
AI.method: 本文引入InterPartAbility，一种可解释的TI-ReID方法，其核心在于执行显式部件匹配并实现短语-区域接地。为此，提出了一种新的开放词汇、轻量级监督的补丁-短语交互模块（PPIM），用于在概念级别指导下训练标准TI-ReID模型。PPIM通过概念化的部件短语鼓励模型关注对应的图像区域。此外，InterPartAbility进一步约束CLIP ViT自注意力，使其产生与每个部件级短语对齐的空间集中补丁激活，从而生成接地的解释图。为了量化评估可解释性，该方法还引入了一种TI-ReID的定量可解释性协议，包括基于扰动的评估指标，例如反事实区域掩蔽。
AI.result: InterPartAbility在CUHK-PEDES和ICFG-PEDES等具有挑战性的基准测试中，在提出的定量可解释性指标下实现了最先进（SOTA）的可解释性性能，同时保持了有竞争力的检索精度。
AI.conclusion: InterPartAbility通过显式部件匹配和短语-区域接地，显著提高了文本到图像行人重识别的可解释性。该方法在保持检索精度的同时，在定量可解释性评估中达到了最先进的性能。
AI.translation: 文本到图像行人重识别（TI-ReID）依赖自然语言文本描述从大量图像库中检索最匹配的个体。虽然最近的大型视觉语言模型（VLMs）取得了强大的检索性能，但它们的决策在很大程度上仍然不可解释。现有的TI-ReID可解释性方法仅依赖于槽注意力来突出关注区域，但未能可靠地将视觉区域绑定到具有语义意义的概念上，将解释限制在有限词汇的定性可视化上。本文介绍了InterPartAbility，一种可解释的TI-ReID方法，它执行显式部件匹配并实现短语-区域接地。提出了一种新的开放词汇、轻量级监督的补丁-短语交互模块（PPIM），用于在概念级指导下训练标准TI-ReID模型。基于概念的部件短语提供证据，鼓励模型关注对应的图像区域。InterPartAbility进一步约束CLIP ViT自注意力，使其产生与每个部件级短语对齐的空间集中补丁激活，从而生成接地的解释图。通过调整基于扰动的评估指标，引入了一种TI-ReID的定量可解释性协议，包括反事实区域掩蔽，用于测量当移除排名靠前的解释区域时检索性能的下降。在CUHK-PEDES和ICFG-PEDES等具有挑战性的基准测试上的实证结果表明，InterPartAbility在这些指标下实现了最先进（SOTA）的可解释性性能，同时保持了有竞争力的检索精度。
AI.summary: 本文提出InterPartAbility，一种可解释的文本到图像行人重识别（TI-ReID）方法，旨在解决现有模型缺乏可解释性的问题。InterPartAbility通过显式部件匹配和短语-区域接地，利用新颖的补丁-短语交互模块（PPIM）和约束的CLIP ViT自注意力，实现了概念级指导和生成接地的解释图。该方法引入了定量可解释性评估协议，并在多个基准测试中展示了最先进的可解释性性能，同时保持了竞争性的检索精度。
AI.keywords: 行人重识别, 可解释性, 文本到图像, 部件匹配, 视觉语言模型
AI.comments: 这篇论文的创新点在于提出了一个结合显式部件匹配和短语-区域接地的可解释性框架，并引入了定量评估指标。PPIM和对CLIP ViT自注意力的约束是其核心技术贡献。该研究解决了TI-ReID领域长期存在的“黑箱”问题，对于提高模型的可信度和应用潜力具有重要意义。

title: Better Models, Faster Training: Sigmoid Attention for single-cell Foundation Models
summary: Training stable biological foundation models requires rethinking attention mechanisms: we find that using sigmoid attention as a drop in replacement for softmax attention a) produces better learned representations: on six diverse single-cell datasets, sigmoid achieves 25% higher cell-type separation, better cell-type cohesion metrics, and lower validation loss, b) faster training, models with sigmoid attention train up to 10% faster than their softmax counterparts, and c) more stable training by eliminating inherent sources of instability in softmax attention. We establish that sigmoid attention has globally bounded derivatives ($\leq 0.25$) as opposed to softmax, and a diagonal Jacobian structure in contrast with softmax's dense coupling, which together help alleviate training instabilities. In stress tests on 160M-parameter bidirectional attention models trained without gradient clipping on 8K-token sequences, softmax diverges catastrophically, with gradients exploding by four orders of magnitude, while sigmoid remains stable. Finally, we implement and open-source TritonSigmoid, an efficient GPU kernel that achieves 515 TFLOPS on H100 GPUs, outperforming both FlashAttention-2 and FlashSigmoid, with native padding support, which is essential for biological sequences. Our results establish sigmoid attention as both theoretically grounded and empirically superior for biological foundation models. Code is available at https://github.com/MSDLLCpapers/triton-sigmoid

AI.title_translation: 更好的模型，更快的训练：用于单细胞基础模型的 Sigmoid 注意力
AI.tldr: Sigmoid 注意力在单细胞基础模型上优于 Softmax 注意力，可提高表示质量、加快训练速度并增强稳定性，并提供了一个高效的 GPU 内核 TritonSigmoid。
AI.motivation: 训练稳定的生物基础模型需要重新思考注意力机制。
AI.method: 将 Softmax 注意力替换为 Sigmoid 注意力，并实现了一个名为 TritonSigmoid 的高效 GPU 内核。
AI.result: 与 Softmax 注意力相比，Sigmoid 注意力在六个单细胞数据集上实现了 25% 的细胞类型分离度提高、更好的细胞类型内聚度指标和更低的验证损失。模型训练速度提高了 10%。Sigmoid 注意力在梯度爆炸的压力测试中保持稳定，而 Softmax 注意力则发散。TritonSigmoid 在 H100 GPU 上实现了 515 TFLOPS。
AI.conclusion: Sigmoid 注意力在理论上具有坚实的基础，并且在单细胞基础模型的实证评估中优于 Softmax 注意力。
AI.translation: 训练稳定的生物基础模型需要重新思考注意力机制：我们发现，使用 Sigmoid 注意力作为 Softmax 注意力的即插即用替代品，a) 产生了更好的学习表示：在六个多样化的单细胞数据集上，Sigmoid 在细胞类型分离度方面提高了 25%，细胞类型内聚度指标更好，验证损失更低，b) 训练更快，具有 Sigmoid 注意力的模型比其 Softmax 对应模型训练速度提高了 10%，c) 训练更稳定，消除了 Softmax 注意力固有的不稳定性来源。我们证明，Sigmoid 注意力的导数是全局有界的（≤ 0.25），而 Softmax 注意力则不然，并且 Sigmoid 注意力具有对角雅可比结构，而 Softmax 注意力则具有密集耦合，这两者都有助于缓解训练不稳定性。在对 1.6 亿参数的双向注意力模型进行训练而未进行梯度裁剪的情况下，并在 8K token 序列上进行压力测试，Softmax 会灾难性地发散，梯度会爆炸四个数量级，而 Sigmoid 保持稳定。最后，我们实现并开源了 TritonSigmoid，这是一个高效的 GPU 内核，在 H100 GPU 上实现了 515 TFLOPS，性能优于 FlashAttention-2 和 FlashSigmoid，并支持原生填充，这对于生物序列至关重要。我们的结果表明，Sigmoid 注意力在理论上具有坚实的基础，并且在生物基础模型方面具有实证优势。代码可在 https://github.com/MSDLLCpapers/triton-sigmoid 获取。
AI.summary: 本研究提出使用 Sigmoid 注意力替代单细胞基础模型中的 Softmax 注意力，以提高训练稳定性和模型性能。研究发现 Sigmoid 注意力能带来更好的表示、更快的训练速度（高达 10%）和更低的验证损失。其理论优势在于全局有界的导数和对角雅可比结构，有效避免了 Softmax 注意力在训练中出现的梯度爆炸等不稳定性问题。此外，研究还实现并开源了高效的 GPU 内核 TritonSigmoid，在 H100 GPU 上实现了卓越的性能。
AI.keywords: Sigmoid 注意力, Softmax 注意力, 单细胞基础模型, 训练稳定性, TritonSigmoid
AI.comments: 该研究为单细胞基础模型提供了一种新颖且有效的注意力机制，解决了现有 Softmax 注意力在训练稳定性和性能方面的局限性。Sigmoid 注意力的理论优势和实证结果令人信服，特别是 TritonSigmoid 的实现，为生物序列处理提供了高效的计算工具。然而，在更广泛的生物学应用和不同类型模型上的泛化能力仍需进一步验证。

title: Unsupervised Electrofacies Classification and Porosity Characterization in the Offshore Keta Basin Using Wireline Logs
summary: This study presents an unsupervised machine learning workflow for electrofacies analysis in the offshore Keta Basin, Ghana, where core data are scarce. Six standard wireline logs from Well~C were analysed over a depth interval comprising approximately $11{,}195$ samples. K-means clustering was applied in multivariate log space, with the clustering structure evaluated using inertia and silhouette diagnostics. Four clusters were identified, supported by an average silhouette coefficient of approximately $0.50$, indicating moderate but meaningful separation. The resulting electrofacies exhibit systematic, depth-continuous patterns associated with variations in clay content, porosity, and rock framework properties, forming a geological continuum from shale-dominated to cleaner sandstone-dominated units. The results demonstrate that log-only, unsupervised clustering supported by quantitative metrics provides a robust and reproducible framework for subsurface characterisation. The proposed workflow offers a practical tool for early-stage formation evaluation in frontier offshore basins and a foundation for future integrated studies.

AI.title_translation: 离岸Keta盆地无监督电相分类和孔隙度表征使用测井曲线
AI.tldr: 在岩心数据稀缺的离岸Keta盆地，本研究利用无监督机器学习（K-means聚类）对测井曲线进行电相分类和孔隙度表征，识别出四种电相，为早期地层评价提供了实用工具。
AI.motivation: 在岩心数据稀缺的加纳离岸Keta盆地进行电相分析。
AI.method: 本研究提出了一种无监督机器学习工作流程进行电相分析。具体方法包括：分析C井的六条标准测井曲线，在多变量测井空间中应用K-means聚类，并使用惯性（inertia）和轮廓系数（silhouette diagnostics）评估聚类结构。
AI.result: 识别出四个电相聚类，平均轮廓系数约为0.50，表明中等但有意义的分离。这些电相表现出系统性、深度连续的模式，与粘土含量、孔隙度以及岩石骨架特性的变化相关，形成了从页岩主导到更干净的砂岩主导单元的地质连续体。结果表明，仅使用测井数据、由定量指标支持的无监督聚类为地下表征提供了一个稳健且可重现的框架。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的工作流程为前缘离岸盆地的早期地层评价提供了一个实用工具，并为未来的综合研究奠定了基础。
AI.translation: 本研究提出了一种在加纳离岸Keta盆地进行电相分析的无监督机器学习工作流程，该地区岩心数据稀缺。对C井的六条标准测井曲线进行了分析，深度区间包含大约11,195个样本。在多变量测井空间中应用了K-means聚类，并使用惯性（inertia）和轮廓系数（silhouette diagnostics）评估聚类结构。识别出四个聚类，平均轮廓系数约为0.50，表明中等但有意义的分离。由此产生的电相表现出系统性、深度连续的模式，与粘土含量、孔隙度以及岩石骨架特性的变化相关，形成了从页岩主导到更干净的砂岩主导单元的地质连续体。结果表明，仅使用测井数据、由定量指标支持的无监督聚类为地下表征提供了一个稳健且可重现的框架。所提出的工作流程为前缘离岸盆地的早期地层评价提供了一个实用工具，并为未来的综合研究奠定了基础。
AI.summary: 本研究在岩心数据稀缺的加纳离岸Keta盆地，利用无监督机器学习（K-means聚类）对C井的六条测井曲线进行了电相分类和孔隙度表征。通过惯性和轮廓系数诊断，成功识别出四种具有地质意义的电相，这些电相反映了粘土含量、孔隙度等属性的连续变化。研究结果证明了仅使用测井数据的无监督聚类方法在地下表征方面的稳健性和可重复性，为前缘离岸盆地的早期地层评价提供了一个实用且有前景的工具。
AI.keywords: 电相分类, 无监督机器学习, 测井曲线, K-means聚类, Keta盆地
AI.comments: 这项研究通过在岩心数据稀缺的地区应用无监督机器学习方法进行电相分类，展示了其创新性。它提供了一种稳健且可重复的替代方案，对于早期地层评价尤其重要。其局限性可能在于对聚类结果的地质解释仍需专家知识，且0.50的轮廓系数虽有意义但并非强分离。

title: Lightweight Distillation of SAM 3 and DINOv3 for Edge-Deployable Individual-Level Livestock Monitoring and Longitudinal Visual Analytics
summary: Foundation-model pipelines for individual-level livestock monitoring -- combining open-vocabulary detection, promptable video segmentation, and self-supervised visual embeddings -- have raised the accuracy ceiling of precision livestock farming (PLF), but their GPU memory budgets exceed the envelope of commodity edge accelerators. To close this gap, the 446M-parameter Perception Encoder (PE-ViT-L+) backbone of SAM 3 is distilled into a 40.66M-parameter multi-scale student through three mechanisms: a Feature Pyramid Network student encoder built on TinyViT-21M-512, a four-term direction-then-scale distillation loss, and backbone-substitution inference with sliding-window session pruning that bounds streaming GPU memory growth. The DINOv3 family includes a pre-distilled ViT-S/16 variant (21.6M parameters) released alongside a 6716M-parameter ViT-7B teacher; the ViT-S (21M) variant is adopted as the per-individual embedder. On the Edinburgh Pig dataset, the compressed pipeline reaches 92.29% MOTA and 96.15% IDF1 against the SAM 3 teacher (1.68- and 0.84-percentage-point losses), achieves a 7.77-fold reduction in system-level parameters and a 3.01-fold reduction in peak VRAM (19.52GB -> 6.49GB), and reaches 97.34% top-1 accuracy with 91.67% macro-F1 on nine-class pig behaviour classification. The pipeline fits inside an NVIDIA Jetson Orin NX 16GB envelope with 4.9GB of headroom, supporting a proposed -- but not yet empirically validated -- on-device embedding-pool re-identification mechanism whose per-individual footprint of approximately 94MB per animal per year produces a longitudinal visual record amenable to retrospective association with disease, lameness, reproductive, and growth outcome labels.

AI.title_translation: 轻量级蒸馏SAM 3和DINOv3，用于边缘部署的个体级牲畜监测和纵向视觉分析
AI.tldr: 针对边缘设备，通过轻量级蒸馏SAM 3和DINOv3，实现了高效的个体级牲畜监测管道，显著降低了模型参数和显存占用，同时保持高精度。
AI.motivation: 现有的基于基础模型的个体级牲畜监测管道虽然精度高，但其GPU内存预算超出了商用边缘加速器的能力范围，限制了其在边缘设备上的部署。
AI.method: 将SAM 3的446M参数感知编码器（PE-ViT-L+）骨干网络蒸馏成一个40.66M参数的多尺度学生模型，该学生编码器基于TinyViT-21M-512构建，并采用特征金字塔网络。使用一个四项的“方向-然后-尺度”蒸馏损失。通过滑动窗口会话修剪的骨干替换推理来限制流式GPU内存增长。采用DINOv3家族中预蒸馏的ViT-S/16变体（21.6M参数）作为个体嵌入器。
AI.result: 在Edinburgh猪数据集上，压缩后的管道相对于SAM 3教师模型达到了92.29%的MOTA和96.15%的IDF1（分别损失1.68和0.84个百分点）。系统级参数减少了7.77倍，峰值VRAM减少了3.01倍（从19.52GB降至6.49GB）。在九类猪行为分类上达到了97.34%的top-1准确率和91.67%的宏观F1分数。该管道符合NVIDIA Jetson Orin NX 16GB的内存要求，并有4.9GB的余量，支持一个提出的但尚未验证的设备上嵌入池再识别机制，其每年每只动物的个体足迹约为94MB。
AI.conclusion: 通过轻量级蒸馏SAM 3和DINOv3，研究成功开发了一个高效且适用于边缘部署的个体级牲畜监测管道。该管道显著降低了资源消耗，同时保持了高精度，并能支持长期的视觉数据分析，为精准畜牧业提供了可行的解决方案。
AI.translation: 针对个体级牲畜监测的基础模型管道——结合了开放词汇检测、可提示视频分割和自监督视觉嵌入——提高了精准畜牧业（PLF）的准确性上限，但其GPU内存预算超出了商用边缘加速器的能力范围。为弥补这一差距，将SAM 3的446M参数感知编码器（PE-ViT-L+）骨干网络蒸馏成一个40.66M参数的多尺度学生模型，通过三种机制实现：一个基于TinyViT-21M-512构建的特征金字塔网络学生编码器，一个四项的“方向-然后-尺度”蒸馏损失，以及通过滑动窗口会话修剪限制流式GPU内存增长的骨干替换推理。DINOv3家族包括一个预蒸馏的ViT-S/16变体（21.6M参数），与一个6716M参数的ViT-7B教师模型一同发布；其中21M参数的ViT-S变体被采纳为个体嵌入器。在Edinburgh猪数据集上，压缩后的管道相对于SAM 3教师模型达到了92.29%的MOTA和96.15%的IDF1（分别损失了1.68和0.84个百分点），实现了系统级参数7.77倍的减少和峰值VRAM 3.01倍的减少（从19.52GB降至6.49GB），并在九类猪行为分类上达到了97.34%的top-1准确率和91.67%的宏观F1分数。该管道符合NVIDIA Jetson Orin NX 16GB的内存要求，并有4.9GB的余量，支持一个提出的——但尚未经过经验验证的——设备上嵌入池再识别机制，其每年每只动物的个体足迹约为94MB，可生成有利于追溯性关联疾病、跛足、繁殖和生长结果标签的纵向视觉记录。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种轻量级的个体级牲畜监测管道，通过蒸馏SAM 3的感知编码器和DINOv3的嵌入器，使其能够在边缘设备上部署。该方法将SAM 3的骨干网络压缩到40.66M参数，并采用DINOv3的ViT-S作为个体嵌入器。实验结果表明，该管道在保持高精度的同时，显著减少了系统参数和VRAM占用，成功适配如NVIDIA Jetson Orin NX等边缘设备，并支持长期的视觉数据分析，为精准畜牧业提供了高效且资源友好的解决方案。
AI.keywords: 轻量级蒸馏, 边缘部署, 牲畜监测, SAM 3, DINOv3, 精准畜牧业
AI.comments: 这篇论文的创新点在于成功地将大型基础模型（SAM 3和DINOv3）通过轻量级蒸馏技术，优化成适用于边缘计算设备的模型，解决了现有高精度模型在资源受限环境下部署的难题。其提出的多尺度学生编码器、特殊蒸馏损失以及骨干替换推理等机制，为模型压缩和边缘部署提供了有益的参考。这对于推动精准畜牧业的实际应用具有重要意义，尤其是在实时监测和长期数据分析方面。

title: What Influences Readers' and Writers' Perceived Necessity of AI Disclosure?
summary: The growing capability of artificial intelligence (AI) leads to its increasing adoption in writing, spurring discussions around whether writers should disclose their AI use in writing. What influences the perceived necessity of disclosure? We look into this question from three dimensions: perspective (reader or writer of the text), purpose (the goal of reading or writing), and procedural factors (how AI was used in the writing process in terms of replaceability, effortfulness, intentionality, and directness). In a vignette study (N = 727), we find that readers consider disclosure to be more necessary than writers, and disclosure is regarded as more necessary when AI's contribution in writing is irreplaceable, directly incorporated, and when the writer does not intentionally steer AI generation. To our surprise, the writers' intentionality of AI use produces contrasting effects on readers' and writers' perceived necessity of disclosure. Moreover, the effort of writing shows no significant effect on the perceived necessity. This study contributes to the conversation on transparent AI use by revealing readers' and writers' grassroots judgments, providing a unique angle to reflect on existing regulations, and offering insights into how AI disclosure guidance and tools could be designed to better align with readers' and writers' perceptions.

AI.title_translation: 什么影响了读者和作者对AI披露必要性的感知？
AI.tldr: 研究发现，读者比作者更看重AI使用披露，且当AI在写作中扮演不可替代的角色时，披露的必要性被认为更高。
AI.motivation: 随着AI在写作中的广泛应用，关于是否应披露AI使用情况的争议日益增加，研究者旨在探究影响读者和作者对AI披露必要性判断的核心因素。
AI.method: 通过一项包含727名参与者的小插曲（vignette）实验，从视角（读者/作者）、目的和程序性因素（可替代性、努力程度、意图性、直接性）三个维度对AI披露的必要性进行定量研究。
AI.result: 研究发现读者比作者更倾向于认为有必要披露AI使用；当AI的贡献不可替代、直接被引用且作者未主动引导时，披露的必要性更高；此外，作者的意图性在读者与作者之间产生反向影响，而写作的努力程度对披露必要性无显著影响。
AI.conclusion: 该研究证明了AI披露的必要性感知受到视角、AI贡献的可替代性及直接性等因素的显著影响，并强调了在制定披露准则时需充分考虑读者与作者之间的感知鸿沟。
AI.translation: 人工智能（AI）能力的增强导致其在写作中的应用日益增多，引发了关于作者是否应披露其AI使用情况的讨论。什么因素影响了对披露必要性的感知？我们从三个维度探讨了这个问题：视角（文本的读者或作者）、目的（阅读或写作的目标）以及程序性因素（AI在写作过程中在可替代性、努力程度、意图性和直接性方面的使用方式）。在一项小插曲研究（N = 727）中，我们发现读者认为披露比作者认为的更有必要，且当AI在写作中的贡献是不可替代的、被直接纳入的，以及当作者没有刻意引导AI生成时，披露被认为更有必要。令我们惊讶的是，作者使用AI的意图性对读者和作者感知到的披露必要性产生了截然不同的影响。此外，写作的努力程度对感知到的必要性没有显著影响。这项研究通过揭示读者和作者的基层判断，为透明的AI使用对话做出了贡献，为反思现有法规提供了一个独特的视角，并为如何设计AI披露指南和工具以更好地与读者和作者的感知保持一致提供了见解。
AI.summary: 本文探讨了影响读者和作者对AI披露必要性感知的因素。通过实验研究发现，视角差异以及AI在写作中的程序性参与方式（如可替代性、直接性等）显著影响了个体的判断，为制定透明的AI使用规范提供了实证依据。
AI.keywords: 人工智能披露, 人机写作, 透明度, 用户感知, 伦理规范
AI.comments: 该研究通过实证方法揭示了人类对于AI内容披露的感知差异，这对于制定AI伦理规范和设计人机协作工具具有重要的现实意义。其创新之处在于区分了作者与读者的视角，并量化了AI使用过程中的多种程序性因素。局限性在于基于小插曲（vignette）的实验可能与真实场景存在偏差。

title: LLM-Enhanced Topical Trend Detection at Snapchat
summary: Automatic detection of topical trends at scale is both challenging and essential for maintaining a dynamic content ecosystem on social media platforms. In this work, we present a large-scale system for identifying emerging topical trends on Snapchat, one of the world's largest short-video social platforms. Our system integrates multimodal topic extraction, time-series burst detection, and LLM-based consolidation and enrichment to enable accurate and timely trend discovery. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first published end-to-end system for topical trend detection on short-video platforms at production scale. Continuous offline human evaluation over six months demonstrates high precision in identifying meaningful trends. The system has been deployed in production at global scale and applied to downstream surfaces including content ranking and search, driving measurable improvements in content freshness and user experience.

AI.title_translation: Snapchat上的LLM增强主题趋势检测
AI.tldr: Snapchat开发了一个大规模系统，利用多模态主题提取、时间序列爆发检测和LLM来检测新兴的主题趋势，并在生产环境中部署，以提高内容新鲜度和用户体验。
AI.motivation: 在社交媒体平台上大规模自动检测主题趋势对于维护动态内容生态系统至关重要，但具有挑战性。
AI.method: 该系统集成了多模态主题提取、时间序列爆发检测以及基于LLM的合并和丰富。
AI.result: 该系统在生产环境中已成功部署，并在离线人类评估中显示出高精度，同时通过下游应用（如内容排名和搜索）驱动了内容新鲜度和用户体验的显著改善。
AI.conclusion: 该系统是首个在短视频平台上大规模生产的主题趋势检测端到端系统，已成功部署并证明了其有效性。
AI.translation: 大规模实时检测主题趋势既具挑战性又对维护社交媒体平台上的动态内容生态系统至关重要。在本研究中，我们提出了一个用于识别Snapchat（世界上最大的短视频社交平台之一）上新兴主题趋势的大规模系统。我们的系统集成了多模态主题提取、时间序列爆发检测以及基于LLM的合并和丰富，以实现准确及时的趋势发现。据我们所知，这是首个在生产规模的短视频平台上用于主题趋势检测的已发布端到端系统。为期六个月的持续离线人类评估证明了识别有意义趋势的高精度。该系统已在全球范围内投入生产部署，并应用于内容排名和搜索等下游服务，从而显著改善了内容新鲜度和用户体验。
AI.summary: 本研究介绍了一个在Snapchat上大规模检测主题趋势的系统，该系统结合了多模态主题提取、时间序列爆发检测和LLM技术。该系统首次实现了在短视频平台上进行生产规模的端到端趋势检测，并通过了为期六个月的离线人类评估，证明了其高精度。该系统已在全球范围内成功部署，并应用于内容排名和搜索等功能，有效提升了内容新鲜度和用户体验。
AI.keywords: 主题趋势检测, Snapchat, LLM, 短视频平台, 多模态提取
AI.comments: 该论文介绍了Snapchat上一个大规模主题趋势检测系统，该系统结合了多种先进技术，并在生产环境中得到了成功应用，具有重要的实际意义和研究价值。这是首个在短视频平台上实现生产规模端到端检测的系统，其持续的离线人类评估和实际应用效果证明了其有效性。

title: TRUST: A Framework for Decentralized AI Service v.0.1
summary: Large Reasoning Models (LRMs) and Multi-Agent Systems (MAS) in high-stakes domains demand reliable verification, yet centralized approaches suffer four limitations: (1) Robustness, with single points of failure vulnerable to attacks and bias; (2) Scalability, as reasoning complexity creates bottlenecks; (3) Opacity, as hidden auditing erodes trust; and (4) Privacy, as exposed reasoning traces risk model theft. We introduce TRUST (Transparent, Robust, and Unified Services for Trustworthy AI), a decentralized framework with three innovations: (i) Hierarchical Directed Acyclic Graphs (HDAGs) that decompose Chain-of-Thought reasoning into five abstraction levels for parallel distributed auditing; (ii) the DAAN protocol, which projects multi-agent interactions into Causal Interaction Graphs (CIGs) for deterministic root-cause attribution; and (iii) a multi-tier consensus mechanism among computational checkers, LLM evaluators, and human experts with stake-weighted voting that guarantees correctness under 30% adversarial participation. We prove a Safety-Profitability Theorem ensuring honest auditors profit while malicious actors incur losses. All decisions are recorded on-chain, while privacy-by-design segmentation prevents reconstruction of proprietary logic. Across multiple LLMs and benchmarks, TRUST attains 72.4% accuracy (4-18% above baselines) and remains resilient against 20% corruption. DAAN reaches 70% root-cause attribution (vs. 54-63% for standard methods) with 60% token savings. Human studies validate the design (F1 = 0.89, Brier = 0.074). The framework supports (A1) decentralized auditing, (A2) tamper-proof leaderboards, (A3) trustless data annotation, and (A4) governed autonomous agents, pioneering decentralized AI auditing for safe, accountable deployment of reasoning-capable systems.

AI.title_translation: TRUST：一个去中心化的AI服务框架 v.0.1
AI.tldr: TRUST是一个去中心化的AI服务框架，利用HDAGs和DAAN协议解决了大型推理模型（LRMs）和多智能体系统（MAS）在可验证性、鲁棒性、可扩展性、透明度和隐私方面的挑战，通过多层共识机制和链上记录，提高了准确性和根源归因能力，并确保了诚实审计者的利润。
AI.motivation: 大型推理模型（LRMs）和多智能体系统（MAS）在高风险领域需要可靠的验证，但中心化方法在鲁棒性、可扩展性、透明度和隐私方面存在局限性。
AI.method: 引入了TRUST（Transparent, Robust, and Unified Services for Trustworthy AI）框架，包含三个创新：1. 分层有向无环图（HDAGs）将思维链推理分解为五个抽象级别以进行分布式审计；2. DAAN协议将多智能体交互投影到因果交互图（CIGs）以进行确定性根源归因；3. 多层共识机制（计算检查器、LLM评估者、人类专家）采用基于权益的投票，确保在30%的对抗性参与下仍能保持正确性。
AI.result: TRUST框架的准确率达到72.4%（比基线高4-18%），并能抵御20%的腐败。DAAN协议的根源归因能力达到70%（优于标准方法54-63%），并节省60%的代币。人类研究验证了该设计的有效性（F1=0.89, Brier=0.074）。
AI.conclusion: TRUST框架通过HDAGs、DAAN协议和多层共识机制，为去中心化AI审计提供了安全、可问责的解决方案，支持去中心化审计、防篡改排行榜、无需信任的数据标注和受治理的自主代理，从而安全地部署具备推理能力的系统。
AI.translation: 大型推理模型（LRMs）和多智能体系统（MAS）在高风险领域需要可靠的验证，但中心化方法存在四个局限性：(1) 鲁棒性，单点故障容易受到攻击和偏见的影响；(2) 可扩展性，推理复杂性会造成瓶颈；(3) 不透明性，隐藏的审计会侵蚀信任；(4) 隐私，暴露的推理痕迹有模型被盗的风险。我们引入了TRUST（Transparent, Robust, and Unified Services for Trustworthy AI），一个具有三个创新的去中心化框架：(i) 分层有向无环图（HDAGs）将思维链推理分解为五个抽象级别，以进行并行分布式审计；(ii) DAAN协议将多智能体交互投影到因果交互图（CIGs），以进行确定性根源归因；(iii) 计算检查器、LLM评估者和人类专家之间的多层共识机制，采用基于权益的投票，确保在30%的对抗性参与下仍能保持正确性。我们证明了安全-盈利能力定理，确保诚实的审计者获利，而恶意行为者则遭受损失。所有决策都记录在链上，而“设计即隐私”的分割可防止专有逻辑被重建。在多个LLM和基准测试中，TRUST的准确率达到72.4%（比基线高4-18%），并能抵御20%的腐败。DAAN协议的根源归因能力达到70%（优于标准方法54-63%），并节省60%的代币。人类研究验证了该设计的有效性（F1=0.89, Brier=0.074）。该框架支持（A1）去中心化审计、（A2）防篡改排行榜、（A3）无需信任的数据标注和（A4）受治理的自主代理，开创了去中心化AI审计的先河，以实现具备推理能力的系统的安全、可问责的部署。
AI.summary: TRUST是一个创新的去中心化AI服务框架，旨在解决中心化方法在验证大型推理模型（LRMs）和多智能体系统（MAS）时面临的鲁棒性、可扩展性、透明度和隐私挑战。该框架通过分层有向无环图（HDAGs）实现分布式审计，利用DAAN协议进行因果根源归因，并结合多层共识机制确保决策的正确性。实验结果表明，TRUST在准确率、根源归因和代币节省方面均优于现有方法，并能在对抗性环境下保持稳定。该框架支持多种去中心化应用，推动了安全、可问责的AI系统部署。
AI.keywords: 去中心化AI, 大型推理模型, 多智能体系统, 可验证性, 分布式审计
AI.comments: 该框架在解决中心化AI验证的痛点方面提出了创新的解决方案，特别是HDAGs和DAAN协议的设计具有潜力。多层共识机制和安全-盈利能力定理为激励诚实审计和保证系统可靠性提供了理论基础。然而，框架的实际部署复杂性、不同抽象级别HDAGs的性能影响以及DAAN协议在处理更复杂交互时的鲁棒性仍需进一步研究和验证。

title: Unpacking Vibe Coding: Help-Seeking Processes in Student-AI Interactions While Programming
comments: Accepted by the 27th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence in Education (AIED'26)
summary: Generative AI is reshaping higher education programming through vibe coding, where students collaborate with AI via natural language rather than writing code line-by-line. We conceptualize this practice as help-seeking, analyzing 19,418 interaction turns from 110 undergraduate students. Using inductive coding and Heterogeneous Transition Network Analysis, we examined interaction sequences to compare top- and low-performing students. Results reveal that top performers engaged in instrumental help-seeking -- inquiry and exploration -- eliciting tutor-like AI responses. In contrast, low performers relied on executive help-seeking, frequently delegating tasks and prompting the AI to assume an executor role focused on ready-made solutions. These findings indicate that currently generative AI mirrors student intent (whether productive or passive) rather than optimizing for learning. To evolve from tools to teammates, AI systems must move beyond passive compliance. We argue for pedagogically aligned design that detect unproductive delegation and adaptively steer educational interactions toward inquiry, ensuring student-AI partnerships augment rather than replace cognitive effort.
comment: Accepted by the 27th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence in Education (AIED'26)

AI.title_translation: 解构 the Vibe Coding：学生-AI编程互动中的求助过程
AI.tldr: 学生通过“Vibe Coding”与AI协作编程，这是一种基于自然语言的求助过程。研究发现，优秀学生倾向于进行探究性求助，而表现不佳的学生则倾向于将任务委托给AI。目前的生成式AI会模仿学生意图，而不是优化学习。未来的AI应设计成能识别无效委托，并引导学生进行探究，以促进学习。
AI.motivation: 随着生成式AI在高等教育编程中的应用日益广泛，学生通过自然语言与AI协作（即“vibe coding”）成为一种新的学习方式。理解这种互动的本质，特别是学生如何寻求帮助，对于优化AI在教育中的作用至关重要。
AI.method: 研究分析了110名本科生在编程时与AI交互的19,418个回合。研究者采用了归纳编码和异构转移网络分析的方法，比较了高绩效和低绩效学生的互动序列，以识别他们不同的求助策略。
AI.result: 研究结果显示，高绩效学生倾向于进行“工具性求助”，表现为询问和探索，并引导AI给出类似导师的回应。而低绩效学生则更多地进行“执行性求助”，频繁地将任务委托给AI，并促使AI扮演一个专注于现成解决方案的执行者角色。
AI.conclusion: 目前，生成式AI在编程互动中主要反映了学生是积极探究还是被动依赖，而非主动促进学习。为了让AI从单纯的工具转变为学习伙伴，它们需要超越被动满足学生指令的能力。研究者主张，未来的AI系统在设计上应与教学法保持一致，能够识别并干预无效的任务委托，并主动引导学生进行探究，从而确保学生-AI的合作能够增强而非取代学生的认知努力。
AI.translation: 生成式AI正在通过“vibe coding”重塑高等教育编程，学生通过自然语言与AI协作，而不是逐行编写代码。我们将这种实践概念化为一种求助过程，分析了来自110名本科生的19,418个互动回合。我们使用归纳编码和异构转移网络分析，检查了互动序列以比较顶尖和表现不佳的学生。结果显示，顶尖学生进行了工具性求助——探究和探索——引发了类似导师的AI回应。相比之下，表现不佳的学生依赖于执行性求助，频繁地将任务委托给AI，并促使AI扮演一个专注于现成解决方案的执行者角色。这些发现表明，目前的生成式AI反映了学生意图（无论是积极的还是被动的），而不是优化学习。为了从工具转变为队友，AI系统必须超越被动合规。我们主张进行教学法上一致的设计，以检测无生产力的委托，并自适应地将教育互动引导至探究，确保学生-AI伙伴关系能够增强而非取代认知努力。
AI.summary: 本研究探讨了学生在编程时如何通过“vibe coding”与生成式AI进行互动和求助。通过分析大量学生-AI互动数据，研究发现高绩效学生倾向于进行探究性的求助，而低绩效学生则倾向于将任务委托给AI。研究强调，目前的AI更多地是模仿学生意图，而非促进学习，并提出未来的AI应具备识别和引导学生进行更具建设性探究的能力，以真正成为学生的学习伙伴。
AI.keywords: Vibe Coding, 求助过程, 生成式AI, 学生-AI互动, 编程教育
AI.comments: 这项研究具有重要的现实意义，它揭示了当前生成式AI在教育场景中可能存在的局限性，即被动响应学生需求而非主动促进学习。研究提出的“工具性求助”和“执行性求助”的区分，为理解学生与AI的互动模式提供了新的视角。然而，研究也指出了AI在设计上的不足，并提出了未来AI系统应具备的教学适应性，这为AI在教育领域的进一步发展指明了方向。未来的研究可以进一步探索如何具体设计能够有效检测“无生产力委托”并引导学生探究的AI机制。

title: Cross-Lingual Response Consistency in Large Language Models: An ILR-Informed Evaluation of Claude Across Six Languages
comments: 12 prompt clusters 6 languages 3 runs; data and code at github.com/camelbal-ship-it/crosslingual-claude-eval
summary: This paper introduces a systematic evaluation framework grounded in the Interagency Language Roundtable (ILR) Skill Level Descriptions and applies it to Claude (Sonnet 4.6) across six languages: English, French, Romanian, Spanish, Italian, and German. We administer a battery of 12 semantically equivalent prompt clusters spanning ILR complexity levels 1 through 3+, collect 216 responses (12 prompts, 6 languages, 3 runs), and analyze outputs through a two-layer methodology combining automated quantitative metrics with expert ILR qualitative assessment. Quantitative analysis reveals that French responses are approximately 30% longer than German responses on identical prompts, and that creative and affective clusters show the highest cross-lingual surface divergence. Qualitative analysis, conducted by a six-language professional with 12 years of ILR/OPI assessment experience, identifies five cross-lingual variation patterns: systematic differences in pragmatic disambiguation strategies, aesthetic and literary tradition divergence in creative output, language-internal technical terminology norms, cultural calibration gaps evidenced by the absence of culture-specific content in favor of culturally neutralized templates, and language-specific institutional referral behavior in emotional support responses. We argue that ILR-informed expert judgment applied to LLM outputs constitutes a novel and underreported evaluation methodology that complements purely computational benchmarks, and that cross-lingual output variation in Claude is interpretable, domain-dependent, and consequential for equitable multilingual AI deployment.

title: RCMAES: A Robust CMA-ES Variant for CEC2026 Competition
comments: 6 pages, accepted manuscript for IEEE CEC 2026 competition track
summary: This paper proposes RCMAES, a novel variant of the Covariance Matrix Adaptation Evolution Strategy (CMA-ES) for CEC benchmark optimization. RCMAES integrates a dimension-dependent nonlinear population-size reduction strategy with an adaptive restart mechanism within a pure CMA-ES framework. RCMAES is evaluated on three benchmark suites (CEC2017, CEC2020, and CEC2022) and compared with state-of-the-art DE algorithms as well as its closely related counterpart, BIPOP-aCMAES. Experimental results show that RCMAES achieves competitive and robust performance across all benchmarks.

title: Improved Approximation Algorithm for Maximum Balanced Biclique
summary: We study the Maximum Balanced Biclique (MBB) problem: Given a bipartite graph $G$ with $n$ vertices on each side, find a balanced biclique in $G$ with maximum size. We give a polynomial-time $\left(\frac{n}{\widetildeΩ\left((\log n)^3\right)}\right)$-approximation algorithm for the problem, which improves upon an $\left(\frac{n}{Ω\left((\log n)^2\right)}\right)$-approximation by Chalermsook et al. (2020) and answers their open question. Furthermore, our approximation ratio matches that of the maximum clique problem by Feige (2004) up to an $O(\log \log n)$ factor.

title: New Diameter Approximations via Distance Oracle Techniques
summary:
Computing the diameter of a graph is a problem of great interest both in general algorithms research and specifically within fine-grained complexity, where it is a cornerstone hard problem. Recent work has achieved a full conditional lower bound tradeoff curve for both directed and undirected graphs. However, the best known upper bounds do not match the lower bounds. In particular, the best known approximation scheme for undirected graph diameter has not been improved. Moreover, this scheme is randomized and no similar deterministic scheme is known.
  Another fundamental field of research in shortest paths computation is the construction of approximate distance oracles. Thorup and Zwick [JACM'05] provided the first such distance oracle with constant query time and (conditionally) optimal space, and in the years since many advances have led to a vast toolbox of techniques and data structures.
  These two areas of research seem natural to combine since they both concern approximating shortest paths. However, the known diameter approximation algorithms only use a small subset of the techniques used in distance oracles research. In this work we show that in fact approximate diameter and distance oracles are intricately connected.
  We first demonstrate a strong connection between the current best known diameter approximation scheme of Cairo, Grossi and Rizzi ("CGR") and the $(2k-1)$-approximate distance oracle of Thorup and Zwick. This allows us to derandomize the CGR algorithm and obtain the first deterministic diameter approximation tradeoff.
  We further derandomize other central techniques in the field of distance oracles and use them to achieve new deterministic diameter approximation algorithms. Finally, we show how these new techniques can be used to derandomize many current best known results in various fields of shortest paths approximations.

title: Enhancing Linux Privilege Escalation Attack Capabilities of Local LLM Agents
summary:
Recent research has demonstrated the potential of Large Language Models (LLMs) for autonomous penetration testing, particularly when using cloud-based restricted-weight models. However, reliance on such models introduces security, privacy, and sovereignty concerns, motivating the use of locally hosted open-weight alternatives. Prior work shows that small open-weight models perform poorly on automated Linux privilege escalation, limiting their practical applicability.
  In this paper, we present a systematic empirical study of whether targeted system-level and prompting interventions can bridge this performance gap. We analyze failure modes of open-weight models in autonomous privilege escalation, map them to established enhancement techniques, and evaluate five concrete interventions (chain-of-thought prompting, retrieval-augmented generation, structured prompts, history compression, and reflective analysis) implemented as extensions to hackingBuddyGPT.
  Our results show that open-weight models can match or outperform cloud-based baselines such as GPT-4o. With our treatments enabled, Llama3.1 70B exploits 83% of tested vulnerabilities, while smaller models including Llama3.1 8B and Qwen2.5 7B achieve 67% when using guidance. A full-factorial ablation study over all treatment combinations reveals that reflection-based treatments contribute most, while also identifying vulnerability discovery as a remaining bottleneck for local models.

title: How to Guide Your Flow: Few-Step Alignment via Flow Map Reward Guidance
summary: In generative modeling, we often wish to produce samples that maximize a user-specified reward such as aesthetic quality or alignment with human preferences, a problem known as guidance. Despite their widespread use, existing guidance methods either require expensive multi-particle, many-step schemes or rely on poorly understood approximations. We reformulate guidance as a deterministic optimal control problem, yielding a hierarchy of algorithms that subsumes existing approaches at the coarsest level. We show that the flow map, an object of significant recent interest for its role in fast inference, arises naturally in the optimal solution. Based on this observation, we propose Flow Map Reward Guidance (FMRG): a training-free, single-trajectory framework that uses the flow map to both integrate and guide the flow. At text-to-image scale, FMRG matches or surpasses baselines across inverse problems, style transfer, human preferences, and VLM rewards with as few as 3 NFEs, giving at least an order-of-magnitude speedup in comparison to prior state of the art.

title: CI-Repair-Bench: A Repository-Aware Benchmark for Automated Patch Validation via CI Workflows
summary: Continuous Integration (CI) enforces repository-level correctness through multi-stage workflows and is central to modern software development, yet diagnosing and repairing CI failures remains challenging. Unlike traditional program repair, CI failures frequently involve non-code artifacts, environment and dependency issues, noisy execution logs, and workflow-level constraints. Existing program repair benchmarks fall short in this setting: they are largely test-centric, restrict repairs to source code, assume fixed execution environments, and evaluate under simplified CI workflows that do not reflect real repository-level validation. We introduce CI-Repair-Bench, a benchmark for CI-verified, repository-level program repair constructed from real GitHub Actions executions. It contains 567 CI failure instances from 103 repositories and evaluates repair correctness exclusively through full CI re-execution under original workflows. Failures are categorized into 12 CI error types, enabling fine-grained, error-type-aware evaluation. To demonstrate benchmark usage, we include a reference CI repair workflow that analyzes CI logs to localize faults and generate candidate patches. Empirical results show that automated repair is most effective for localized, tool-enforced failures such as formatting and linting, while environment, dependency, and configuration-related failures remain challenging; the best-performing LLM achieves an 18.9% repair success rate. CI-Repair-Bench provides a realistic evaluation foundation for advancing research on CI-native automated program repair.

title: ConformaDecompose: Explaining Uncertainty via Calibration Localization
comments: This is the accepted author version of a paper to appear in the proceedings of the World Explainable AI Conference (Springer). The final version will be available via Springer. This manuscript introduces ConformaDecompose, a framework for instance-wise uncertainty explainability via calibration localisation
summary: Conformal Prediction provides distribution-free prediction intervals with guaranteed coverage, but its reliance on a single global calibration threshold obscures the sources of uncertainty at the instance level. In particular, it conflates irreducible noise with uncertainty induced by heterogeneous training data (aleatoric), model limitations, or calibration mismatch (epistemic), offering little insight into why an interval is wide or whether it could be reduced. We introduce an uncertainty-aware explainability framework that analyses the reducibility of calibration-induced epistemic conformal uncertainty via progressive calibration localisation for regression tasks. The approach is diagnostic rather than causal: it does not estimate true aleatoric or epistemic uncertainty, but explains how conformal intervals contract and stabilise as calibration support is localised around a test instance. Across benchmarks and real-world data, absolute reducible uncertainty aligns with epistemic proxies, while its relative contribution varies by task, revealing regimes hidden by interval width. This instance-level view complements conformal uncertainty, enhancing interpretability without altering the predictor or coverage.
