We contribute: (i) a framework of six guiding principles, four curriculum domains, five ethical competencies, and an age-banded progression from lower primary to upper secondary; (ii) a comparative analysis of continental and national policy contexts; (iii) an explicit mapping between global AI-ethics principles and Ubuntu-informed relational ethics; (iv) a planned empirical validation programme combining a Delphi study, teacher surveys across anglophone, francophone, lusophone, and arabophone contexts, and multi-country classroom piloting; and (v) targeted recommendations for policymakers, educators, civil society, and international partners. We argue that an ethical AI curriculum can serve as a transformative tool for equity, innovation, and social justice, and outline a research agenda to embed ethics, resilience, and critical thinking at the core of Africa's digital future.
comment: 18 pages, 5 figures. Conceptual framework; empirical validation programme in progress

title: Social Media Data Toolkit: Standardization and Anonymization of Social Network Datasets
summary: The rapid diversification of social media platforms and the increasing restrictions on official APIs have significantly complicated cross-platform analysis. Researchers are often forced to rely on heterogeneous datasets obtained through web scraping and historical archives; however they often lack structural consistency. Prior to conducting cross-platform social media analyses, one needs to answer three critical questions: (1) What makes platforms different and similar? (2) How were the datasets collected? (3) How can we align the datasets of different platforms to conduct fair analyses? To address these questions, we introduce the Social Media Data Toolkit (\projectname{}), a comprehensive Python framework designed for the standardization, anonymization, and enrichment of social network datasets. \projectname{} unifies diverse data structures into a generic schema comprising Communities, Accounts, Posts, Actions, and Entities to facilitate multi-platform research. The framework features a configurable anonymization module to secure Personally Identifiable Information (PII) and an extendable enrichment layer that integrates Large Language Models (LLMs) and network analysis tools for downstream tasks such as stance detection and toxicity scoring without creating codebase for different datasets. We demonstrate the versatility of \projectname{} through four case studies spanning from textual analysis of the content to network analysis across platforms. To offer reproducible social media research, \projectname{} is released as an open-source tool featuring detailed documentation and practical guides for researchers at any skill-level. It can be accessed at github.com/ViralLab/SMDT and varollab.com/SMDT.

title: ExoActor: Exocentric Video Generation as Generalizable Interactive Humanoid Control
comments: Work in progress. Project page: https://baai-agents.github.io/ExoActor/
summary: Humanoid control systems have made significant progress in recent years, yet modeling fluent interaction-rich behavior between a robot, its surrounding environment, and task-relevant objects remains a fundamental challenge. This difficulty arises from the need to jointly capture spatial context, temporal dynamics, robot actions, and task intent at scale, which is a poor match to conventional supervision. We propose ExoActor, a novel framework that leverages the generalization capabilities of large-scale video generation models to address this problem. The key insight in ExoActor is to use third-person video generation as a unified interface for modeling interaction dynamics. Given a task instruction and scene context, ExoActor synthesizes plausible execution processes that implicitly encode coordinated interactions between robot, environment, and objects. Such video output is then transformed into executable humanoid behaviors through a pipeline that estimates human motion and executes it via a general motion controller, yielding a task-conditioned behavior sequence. To validate the proposed framework, we implement it as an end-to-end system and demonstrate its generalization to new scenarios without additional real-world data collection. Furthermore, we conclude by discussing limitations of the current implementation and outlining promising directions for future research, illustrating how ExoActor provides a scalable approach to modeling interaction-rich humanoid behaviors, potentially opening a new avenue for generative models to advance general-purpose humanoid intelligence.
comment: Work in progress. Project page: https://baai-agents.github.io/ExoActor/

title: Linguistically Informed Multimodal Fusion for Vietnamese Scene-Text Image Captioning: Dataset, Graph Framework, and Phonological Attention
summary: Scene-text image captioning requires fusing three information streams -- visual features, OCR-detected text, and linguistic knowledge -- to generate descriptions that faithfully integrate text visible in images. Existing fusion approaches treat text as language-agnostic, which fails for Vietnamese: a tonal language where diacritics alter word meaning, OCR errors are pervasive, and word boundaries are ambiguous. We argue that Vietnamese scene-text captioning demands \textit{linguistically informed multimodal fusion}, where language-specific structural knowledge is explicitly incorporated into the fusion mechanism. Motivated from these insights, we propose \textbf{HSTFG} (Heterogeneous Scene-Text Fusion Graph), a general-purpose graph fusion framework with learned spatial attention bias, and show through topology analysis that cross-modal graph edges are harmful for scene-text fusion. Building on this finding, we design \textbf{PhonoSTFG} (Phonological Scene-Text Fusion Graph) which specializes graph-level fusion for Vietnamese linguistic reasoning. To support evaluation, we introduce \textbf{ViTextCaps}, the first large-scale Vietnamese scene-text captioning dataset (\textbf{15{,}729} images with \textbf{74{,}970} captions), with comprehensive linguistic analysis showing that 52.8\% of the vocabulary is at risk of diacritic collision.

title: Knowledge Graph Representations for LLM-Based Policy Compliance Reasoning
summary: The risks posed by AI features are increasing as they are rapidly integrated into software applications. In response, regulations and standards for safe and secure AI have been proposed. In this paper, we present an agentic framework that constructs knowledge graphs (KGs) from AI policy documents and retrieves policy-relevant information to answer questions. We build KGs from three AI risk-related polices under two ontology schemas, and then evaluate five LLMs on 42 policy QA tasks spanning six reasoning types, from entity lookup to cross-policy inference, using both heuristic scoring and an LLM-as-judge. KG augmentation improves scores for all five models, and an open, LLM-discovered schema matches or exceeds the formal ontology.

title: How Code Representation Shapes False-Positive Dynamics in Cross-Language LLM Vulnerability Detection
summary:
How code representation format shapes false positive behaviour in cross-language LLM vulnerability detection remains poorly understood. We systematically vary training intensity and code representation format, comparing raw source text with pruned Abstract Syntax Trees at both training time and inference time, across two 8B-parameter LLMs (Qwen3-8B and Llama 3.1-8B-Instruct) fine-tuned on C/C++ data from the NIST Juliet Test Suite (v1.3) and evaluated on Java (OWASP Benchmark v1.2) and Python (BenchmarkPython v0.1).
  Cross-language FPR reflects the joint effect of training-time and inference-time representation, not either alone. Text fine-tuning drives FPR upward monotonically (Qwen3-8B: 0.763 zero-shot, 0.866 pilot, 1.000 full-scale) while F1 remains stable (0.637-0.688), masking the collapse. We argue surface-cue memorisation is the primary mechanism: text fine-tuning encodes C/C++-specific API names and syntactic idioms as vulnerability triggers that fire indiscriminately on target-language code. A cross-representation probe, applying text-trained weights to AST-encoded input without retraining, isolates this: Qwen3-8B FPR drops from 0.866 to 0.583, and 37.2% of false positives revert to true negatives under AST input alone. Direct AST fine-tuning does not preserve the benefit (FPR at least 0.970), as flat linearisation introduces structural surface cues of its own. The pattern replicates across both model families. On BenchmarkPython the AST probe yields FPR=0.554, within 2.9 percentage points of the Java result, despite maximal surface-syntax differences, substantially weakening a domain-shift explanation. These findings motivate a pre-deployment consistency gate, running alerts through both text and AST paths, as a retraining-free filter for false-positive-sensitive settings, at the cost of reduced recall.

title: Improving Calibration in Test-Time Prompt Tuning for Vision-Language Models via Data-Free Flatness-Aware Prompt Pretraining
summary: Test-time prompt tuning (TPT) has emerged as a promising technique for enhancing the adaptability of vision-language models by optimizing textual prompts using unlabeled test data. However, prior studies have observed that TPT often produces poorly calibrated models, raising concerns about the reliability of their predictions. Recent works address this issue by incorporating additional regularization terms that constrain model outputs, which improve calibration but often degrade performance. In this work, we reveal that these regularization strategies implicitly encourage optimization toward flatter minima, and that the sharpness of the loss landscape around adapted prompts is a key factor governing calibration quality. Motivated by this observation, we introduce Flatness-aware Prompt Pretraining (FPP), a simple yet effective pretraining framework for TPT that initializes prompts within flatter regions of the loss landscape prior to adaptation. We show that simply replacing the initialization in existing TPT pipelines--without modifying any other components--is sufficient to improve both calibration and performance. Notably, FPP requires no labeled data and incurs no additional computational costs during test-time tuning, making it highly practical for real-world deployment. The code is available at: https://github.com/YonseiML/fpp.

title: Auditing Frontier Vision-Language Models for Trustworthy Medical VQA: Grounding Failures, Format Collapse, and Domain Adaptation
summary: Deploying vision-language models (VLMs) in clinical settings demands auditable behavior under realistic failure conditions, yet the failure landscape of frontier VLMs on specialized medical inputs is poorly characterized. We audit five recent frontier and grounding-aware VLMs (Gemini~2.5~Pro, GPT-5, o3, GLM-4.5V, Qwen~2.5~VL) on Medical VQA along two trust-relevant axes. Perception: all models localize anatomical and pathological targets poorly -- the best model reaches only 0.23 mean IoU and 19.1% Acc@0.5 -- and exhibit clinically dangerous laterality confusion. Pipeline integration: a self-grounding pipeline, where the same model localizes then answers, degrades VQA accuracy for every model -- driven by both inaccurate localization and format-compliance failures under the two-step prompt (parse failure rises to 70%--99% for Gemini and GPT-5 on VQA-RAD). Replacing predicted boxes with ground-truth annotations recovers and improves VQA accuracy, consistent with the failure residing in the perception module rather than in the decomposition itself. These observational findings identify grounding quality as a primary trustworthiness bottleneck in our SLAKE bounding-box setting. As a complementary fine-tuning follow-up, supervised fine-tuning of Qwen~2.5~VL on combined Med-VQA training data attains the highest reported SLAKE open-ended recall (85.5%) among comparable methods, suggesting that the VQA-level gap is tractable with domain adaptation; whether this also closes the perception/trustworthiness bottleneck is left to future work.

title: Optimized Deferral for Imbalanced Settings
summary: Learning algorithms can be significantly improved by routing complex or uncertain inputs to specialized experts, balancing accuracy with computational cost. This approach, known as learning to defer, is essential in domains like natural language generation, medical diagnosis, and computer vision, where an effective deferral can reduce errors at low extra resource consumption. However, the two-stage learning to defer setting, which leverages existing predictors such as a collection of LLMs or other classifiers, often faces challenges due to an expert imbalance problem. This imbalance can lead to suboptimal performance, with deferral algorithms favoring the majority expert. We present a comprehensive study of two-stage learning to defer in expert imbalance settings. We cast the deferral loss optimization as a novel cost-sensitive learning problem over the input-expert domain. We derive new margin-based loss functions and guarantees tailored to this setting, and develop novel algorithms for cost-sensitive learning. Leveraging these results, we design principled deferral algorithms, MILD (Margin-based Imbalanced Learning to Defer), specifically suited for expert imbalance settings. Extensive experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of our approach, showing clear improvements over existing baselines on both image classification and real-world Large Language Model (LLM) routing tasks.

title: Iterative Multimodal Retrieval-Augmented Generation for Medical Question Answering
summary: Medical retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) systems typically operate on text chunks extracted from biomedical literature, discarding the rich visual content (tables, figures, structured layouts) of original document pages. We propose MED-VRAG, an iterative multimodal RAG framework that retrieves and reasons over PMC document page images instead of OCR'd text. The system pairs ColQwen2.5 patch-level page embeddings with a sharded MapReduce LLM filter, scaling to ~350K pages while keeping Stage-1 retrieval under 30 ms via an offline coarse-to-fine index (C=8 centroids per page, ANN over centroids, exact two-way scoring on the top-R shortlist). A vision-language model (VLM) then iteratively refines its query and accumulates evidence in a memory bank across up to 3 reasoning rounds, with a single iteration costing ~15.9 s and the full three-round pipeline ~47.8 s on 4xA100. Across four medical QA benchmarks (MedQA, MedMCQA, PubMedQA, MMLU-Med), MEDVRAG reaches 78.6% average accuracy. Under controlled comparison with the same Qwen2.5-VL-32B backbone, retrieval contributes a +5.8 point gain over the no-retrieval baseline; we also note a +1.8 point edge over MedRAG + GPT-4 (76.8%), with the caveat that this is a cross-paper rather than head-to-head comparison. Ablations isolate +1.0 from page-image vs text-chunk retrieval, +1.5 from iteration, and +1.0 from the memory bank.

title: AgentEconomist: An End-to-end Agentic System Translating Economic Intuitions into Executable Computational Experiments
summary: A long-standing challenge in economics lies not in the lack of intuition, but in the difficulty of translating intuitive insights into verifiable research. To address this challenge, we introduce AgentEconomist, an end-to-end interactive system designed to translate abstract intuitions into executable computational experiments. Grounded in a domain-specific knowledge base covering over 13,000 high-quality academic papers, the system employs a modular multi-stage architecture. Specifically, the Idea Development Stage generates literature-grounded hypotheses, the Experimental Design Stage configures simulator-aligned experimental parameters and protocols, and the Experimental Execution Stage runs experiments and returns structured analyses. Together, these stages form a human-in-the-loop, iterative workflow that translates economic intuitions into executable computational experiments. Through extensive experiments involving human expert evaluation and large language models (LLMs) as judges, we show that the system generates research ideas with stronger literature grounding and higher novelty and insight than state-of-the-art generic LLMs. Overall, AgentEconomist adopts a human-AI collaboration paradigm that enables researchers to focus on high-level intuitions, while delegating the labor-intensive processes of translation and computational execution to agents.

AI.title_translation: AgentEconomist：一个将经济直觉转化为可执行计算实验的端到端智能体系统
AI.tldr: AgentEconomist是一个端到端智能体系统，旨在帮助经济学家将抽象直觉转化为可验证的计算实验，通过多阶段架构和人类-AI协作，生成更具文献基础和新颖性的研究思想，优于现有通用LLM。
AI.motivation: 经济学中一个长期存在的挑战是，直觉洞察力丰富，但难以将其转化为可验证的研究。
AI.method: AgentEconomist是一个端到端交互式系统，基于包含13,000多篇高质量学术论文的领域特定知识库。它采用模块化多阶段架构，包括思想发展阶段（生成基于文献的假设）、实验设计阶段（配置与模拟器对齐的实验参数和协议）和实验执行阶段（运行实验并返回结构化分析）。该系统形成一个人类参与的迭代工作流，并通过人类专家评估和大型语言模型（LLM）作为评判者的广泛实验进行验证。
AI.result: 实验表明，该系统生成的研s究思想比最先进的通用大型语言模型具有更强的文献基础、更高的新颖性和洞察力。
AI.conclusion: AgentEconomist采纳了人机协作范式，使研究人员能够专注于高层次直觉，同时将翻译和计算执行等劳动密集型过程委托给智能体。
AI.translation: 经济学中一个长期存在的挑战不在于缺乏直觉，而在于难以将直觉洞察力转化为可验证的研究。为了解决这个挑战，我们引入了AgentEconomist，一个旨在将抽象直觉转化为可执行计算实验的端到端交互式系统。该系统以一个涵盖13,000多篇高质量学术论文的领域特定知识库为基础，采用模块化的多阶段架构。具体而言，思想发展阶段生成基于文献的假设，实验设计阶段配置与模拟器对齐的实验参数和协议，实验执行阶段运行实验并返回结构化分析。这些阶段共同形成了一个人类参与的迭代工作流，将经济直觉转化为可执行的计算实验。通过涉及人类专家评估和以大型语言模型（LLM）作为评判者的广泛实验，我们表明该系统生成的研s究思想比最先进的通用LLM具有更强的文献基础、更高的新颖性和洞察力。总的来说，AgentEconomist采纳了一种人机协作范式，使研究人员能够专注于高层次直觉，同时将翻译和计算执行等劳动密集型过程委托给智能体。
AI.summary: AgentEconomist是一个端到端智能体系统，旨在解决经济学中将直觉转化为可验证研究的难题。该系统基于一个庞大的经济学知识库，采用模块化多阶段架构，包括思想发展、实验设计和实验执行，形成一个人机协作的迭代工作流。实验证明，AgentEconomist生成的科研想法在文献基础、新颖性和洞察力方面优于通用LLM，从而使研究人员能专注于高层直觉，并将繁琐的计算实验过程交给AI代理。
AI.keywords: AgentEconomist, 经济学研究, 计算实验, 人机协作, 大型语言模型
AI.comments: 这篇论文提出了一种创新的人机协作范式，将AI智能体应用于经济学研究中，解决了将抽象经济直觉转化为具体可执行计算实验的痛点。其优势在于结合了领域特定知识库和多阶段架构，有效提升了研究思路的文献扎根性、新颖性和洞察力。这对于加速经济学理论验证和实证研究具有重要意义，尤其是在处理复杂经济模型和大规模数据时，能够显著提高研究效率。

title: LLM-as-a-Judge for Human-AI Co-Creation: A Reliability-Aware Evaluation Framework for Coding
summary: LLMs are increasingly employed both as judges for evaluating open-ended outputs and as co-creation partners in AI-assisted programming; yet rigorous evaluation in human-AI co-creation settings remains underdeveloped as judgments must be reliable, comparable across models, and interpretable over multi-turn interaction. To address this gap, a rubric-driven LLM-as-a-Judge framework is presented for contest-style human-AI co-creation in coding and software engineering (SE). The framework is built around schema-constrained judge outputs, validation and repair mechanisms, grouped and split by user and problem to prevent trajectory leakage, and participant-level NONBLIND context. Multiple LLM judges are assessed through a multi-metric protocol covering discrimination (ROC-AUC, PR-AUC), thresholded decision quality (MCC), probabilistic reliability (LogLoss, Brier score, ECE), and inter-judge agreement (Cohen's and Fleiss' k). Human-AI co-creation is further examined through trajectory-level signals, including turn-wise confidence, Success-at-Turn, time-to-success, revision churn, and CodeBLEU. Co-creation success is found to concentrate early, with Success-at-Turn rising to 0.8533 at the first observed turn and stabilizing at 0.8641 by turn 6. Revision behavior, however, remains heterogeneous, suggesting that productive progress can emerge through either incremental refinement or broader restructuring. On the judging side, the best held-out scores reach 0.5937 for ROC-AUC, 0.6904 for PR-AUC, and 0.5000 for MCC test, while inter-judge consistency remains modest overall (mean pairwise Cohen's k = 0.1592, Fleiss' k = 0.0696). Taken together, this work offers an auditable and reproducible evaluation methodology that links reliability-aware LLM judging with trajectory-based analysis of human-AI co-creation, providing a practical evaluation template for future AI-assisted coding and SE.

AI.title_translation: LLM作为评委用于人机协同创作：一种面向编码的可靠性感知评估框架
AI.tldr: 该研究提出了一个可靠性感知的LLM作为评委的框架，用于评估人机协同编码创作，并通过多指标协议评估了LLM评委，并分析了协同创作过程中的轨迹信号，发现协同创作成功集中在早期，但评委间的一致性仍有待提高。
AI.motivation: 在AI辅助编程中，LLM越来越多地被用作评估开放式输出的评委和协同创作伙伴，然而，人机协同创作环境中的严格评估仍然不完善，因为判断必须可靠、模型间可比较，并且在多轮交互中可解释。
AI.method: 研究提出了一个由评分标准驱动的LLM作为评委的框架，用于编码和软件工程中的竞赛式人机协同创作。该框架围绕模式约束的评委输出、验证和修复机制、按用户和问题分组和拆分以防止轨迹泄漏，以及参与者级别的NONBLIND上下文构建。通过多指标协议评估了多个LLM评委，涵盖判别（ROC-AUC, PR-AUC）、阈值决策质量（MCC）、概率可靠性（LogLoss, Brier score, ECE）和评委间一致性（Cohen's 和 Fleiss' k）。通过轨迹级信号进一步检查人机协同创作，包括逐轮置信度、逐轮成功率、成功时间、修订流失和CodeBLEU。
AI.result: 协同创作的成功集中在早期，在第一次观察到的轮次中，逐轮成功率上升到0.8533，到第6轮稳定在0.8641。然而，修订行为仍然异质，表明通过增量改进或更广泛的重构都可以产生富有成效的进展。在评判方面，最佳保留分数在ROC-AUC上达到0.5937，PR-AUC上达到0.6904，MCC测试上达到0.5000，而评委间的一致性总体上仍然适中（平均成对Cohen's k = 0.1592，Fleiss' k = 0.0696）。
AI.conclusion: 这项工作提供了一种可审计和可重现的评估方法，将可靠性感知的LLM评判与基于轨迹的人机协同创作分析联系起来，为未来的AI辅助编码和软件工程提供了一个实用的评估模板。
AI.translation:
LLM作为评委用于人机协同创作：一种可靠性感知评估框架
LLM越来越多地被用作评估开放式输出的评委和AI辅助编程中的协同创作伙伴；然而，人机协同创作环境中的严格评估仍然不完善，因为判断必须可靠、模型间可比较，并且在多轮交互中可解释。为了解决这一差距，本文提出了一个由评分标准驱动的LLM作为评委的框架，用于编码和软件工程（SE）中的竞赛式人机协同创作。该框架围绕模式约束的评委输出、验证和修复机制、按用户和问题分组和拆分以防止轨迹泄漏，以及参与者级别的NONBLIND上下文构建。通过多指标协议评估了多个LLM评委，涵盖判别（ROC-AUC, PR-AUC）、阈值决策质量（MCC）、概率可靠性（LogLoss, Brier score, ECE）和评委间一致性（Cohen's 和 Fleiss' k）。通过轨迹级信号进一步检查人机协同创作，包括逐轮置信度、逐轮成功率、成功时间、修订流失和CodeBLEU。研究发现协同创作的成功集中在早期，在第一次观察到的轮次中，逐轮成功率上升到0.8533，到第6轮稳定在0.8641。然而，修订行为仍然异质，表明通过增量改进或更广泛的重构都可以产生富有成效的进展。在评判方面，最佳保留分数在ROC-AUC上达到0.5937，PR-AUC上达到0.6904，MCC测试上达到0.5000，而评委间的一致性总体上仍然适中（平均成对Cohen's k = 0.1592，Fleiss' k = 0.0696）。总而言之，这项工作提供了一种可审计和可重现的评估方法，将可靠性感知的LLM评判与基于轨迹的人机协同创作分析联系起来，为未来的AI辅助编码和软件工程提供了一个实用的评估模板。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一个针对人机协同编码创作的可靠性感知LLM作为评委的评估框架。该框架采用评分标准驱动，并结合了模式约束的输出、验证修复和上下文管理。研究通过多指标协议评估了LLM评委的判别、决策质量、可靠性和一致性，同时通过轨迹级信号分析了协同创作过程。结果显示协同创作成功倾向于早期发生，但LLM评委间的一致性有待提高。该工作为AI辅助编码和软件工程提供了一种可审计、可重现的评估方法。
AI.keywords: LLM作为评委, 人机协同创作, 编码, 评估框架, 可靠性感知
AI.comments: 本文的创新之处在于将LLM作为评委引入人机协同创作的评估，并提出了一个全面的可靠性感知评估框架。该框架结合了细致的评委输出约束、验证机制以及多维度的评估指标，为理解和衡量人机协同编码的质量提供了新颖的视角。同时，对协同创作轨迹的分析也揭示了创作过程中的动态行为。然而，LLM评委间一致性适中的结果也提示了未来研究需要进一步提升LLM作为评委的鲁棒性和可靠性。

title: Connected Dependability Cage: Run-Time Function and Anomaly Monitoring for the Development and Operation of Safe Automated Vehicles
summary: The advancement of automated vehicles introduces complex safety challenges, particularly in dynamic and unpredictable environments where AI-enabled perception systems must operate reliably. Ensuring compliance with safety standards such as ISO 26262 and ISO/PAS 21448 (SOTIF) is essential for addressing system malfunctions and mitigating unsafe behavior in unknown scenarios. However, as automation levels increase, vehicles must go beyond conventional functional safety by incorporating fail-operational capabilities that enable continued safe operation during system or component failures and the handling of unfamiliar or degraded operational conditions. To address these safety concerns, we propose the Connected Dependability Cage, an architectural framework designed to enable hierarchical fail-operational behavior in AI-enabled perception systems. This framework integrates two complementary monitoring mechanisms: a Function Monitor that oversees multiple heterogeneous AI-based perception pipelines and detects inconsistencies through a voting mechanism, and an Anomaly Monitor that evaluates the reliability of AI perception by detecting unknown or novel objects in scenes that may be excluded from the training dataset. In the presence of critical discrepancies, the system supports graceful degradation, ultimately enabling a transition to a minimal-risk maneuver strategy. Furthermore, whenever either monitor raises a safety flag, an automated data recording process is initiated to facilitate iterative system development and continuous improvement. Both monitors have been implemented and validated through extensive vehicle testing, demonstrating their practical effectiveness in real-world applications.

AI.title_translation: 互联可靠性笼：安全自动驾驶车辆开发与运行时的运行时功能与异常监控
AI.tldr: 该研究提出了互联可靠性笼（Connected Dependability Cage）框架，通过集成功能监控器和异常监控器，实现了AI感知系统的分层容错能力，以应对自动驾驶车辆在复杂环境下的安全挑战，并支持数据记录以促进系统迭代改进。
AI.motivation: 随着自动驾驶汽车级别的提高，需要超越传统功能安全，加入容错能力，以在系统或组件故障、未知或降级运行条件下仍能持续安全运行。
AI.method: 提出互联可靠性笼框架，包含两个监控机制：1. 功能监控器：监控多个异构的AI感知流水线，通过投票机制检测不一致性。2. 异常监控器：检测训练数据集中未包含的未知或新颖物体，评估AI感知的可靠性。在出现关键差异时，支持优雅降级并过渡到最小风险机动策略。任一监控器发出安全警报时，自动启动数据记录。
AI.result: 功能监控器和异常监控器均已实现并通过广泛的车辆测试进行了验证，证明了它们在实际应用中的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 互联可靠性笼框架通过集成功能监控和异常监控，为AI感知系统提供了分层容错能力，有助于满足自动驾驶车辆的安全标准，并能通过数据记录支持持续改进。
AI.translation: 自动驾驶汽车的进步带来了复杂的安全挑战，尤其是在人工智能驱动的感知系统必须可靠运行的动态和不可预测的环境中。确保符合 ISO 26262 和 ISO/PAS 21448 (SOTIF) 等安全标准对于解决系统故障和减轻未知场景下的不安全行为至关重要。然而，随着自动化级别的提高，车辆必须超越传统的Functional Safety，融入容错能力，使其能够在系统或组件发生故障以及处理不熟悉或降级的运行条件时，仍能继续安全运行。为了应对这些安全问题，我们提出了互联可靠性笼（Connected Dependability Cage），这是一个旨在实现人工智能驱动的感知系统分层容错行为的架构框架。该框架集成了两个互补的监控机制：一个功能监控器（Function Monitor），它负责监控多个异构的人工智能感知流水线，并通过投票机制检测不一致性；以及一个异常监控器（Anomaly Monitor），它通过检测场景中可能被排除在训练数据集之外的未知或新颖物体来评估人工智能感知的可靠性。在出现关键差异的情况下，该系统支持优雅降级，最终能够过渡到最小风险机动策略。此外，当任一监控器发出安全警报时，都会启动自动数据记录过程，以促进迭代系统开发和持续改进。这两种监控器都已通过广泛的车辆测试得以实现和验证，证明了它们在实际应用中的实际有效性。
AI.summary: 本研究提出了互联可靠性笼（Connected Dependability Cage）框架，旨在增强自动驾驶车辆AI感知系统的安全性和可靠性。该框架通过集成功能监控器和异常监控器，实现了分层容错能力，能够检测AI感知流水线中的不一致性以及处理训练数据集中未包含的未知或新颖物体。在检测到安全风险时，系统能够实现优雅降级并执行最小风险机动。此外，框架还支持自动数据记录，以促进系统的持续改进和开发。
AI.keywords: 互联可靠性笼, 自动驾驶汽车, AI感知, 功能安全, 容错
AI.comments: 该研究提出的互联可靠性笼框架在应对自动驾驶汽车日益增长的安全挑战方面具有重要意义。通过集成功能和异常监控，并支持容错和最小风险机动，该框架为提高AI感知系统的可靠性和安全性提供了一个有前景的解决方案。然而，实际部署中监控器之间的协调、计算开销以及在极端或前所未见的场景下的性能仍需进一步评估。

title: An adaptive Deep Ritz framework for second-order fully nonlinear partial differential equations
summary: As an alternative to PINNs, a Deep Ritz framework is proposed to solve fully nonlinear PDEs. A least-squares algorithm is advocated to decouple the nonlinearities from the variational features of several fully nonlinear PDEs. A splitting method allows to iteratively solve local nonlinear problems and linear variational problems at each iteration. While existing nonlinear solvers are applied to solve for nonlinearities, we propose a novel coupling with a Deep Ritz neural network approach that is well-suited to the variational flavor of the linear variational problems. An adaptive sampling strategy for the selection of collocation points is incorporated to increase the efficiency of the algorithm without sacrificing its accuracy. Numerical experiments are presented to solve the Dirichlet problem for several fully nonlinear equations, starting with the prototypical Monge-Ampère equation, showing the flexibility of the approach. Numerical results are compared with results obtained using a full PINNs approach. Finally, numerical experiments are extended to address the optimal transport Monge-Ampère problem with transport boundary conditions.

AI.title_translation: 二阶全非线性偏微分方程的自适应深度Ritz框架
AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种自适应深度Ritz框架，作为PINNs的替代方案，用于解决全非线性偏微分方程。该方法结合了最小二乘算法、分裂方法和自适应采样策略，以提高效率和准确性，并通过数值实验展示了其灵活性。
AI.motivation: 为了提供一种替代PINNs的方法来解决全非线性偏微分方程。
AI.method: 本文提出了一种深度Ritz框架。采用最小二乘算法将非线性从变分特征中解耦。使用分裂方法迭代求解局部非线性问题和线性变分问题。提出了一种与深度Ritz神经网络方法的新颖耦合，适用于线性变分问题。引入了用于选择配置点的自适应采样策略，以提高效率而不牺牲精度。
AI.result: 数值实验展示了求解几个全非线性方程（如Monge-Ampère方程）的Dirichlet问题，显示了该方法的灵活性。数值结果与使用完整PINNs方法获得的结果进行了比较。数值实验还扩展到解决具有传输边界条件的最佳传输Monge-Ampère问题。
AI.conclusion: 本文提出的自适应深度Ritz框架是一种灵活且高效的替代PINNs的方法，用于解决二阶全非线性偏微分方程，并在各种数值实验中表现出良好的性能。
AI.translation: 作为PINNs的替代方案，本文提出了一种深度Ritz框架来求解全非线性偏微分方程。采用最小二乘算法将非线性从几个全非线性偏微分方程的变分特征中解耦出来。分裂方法允许在每次迭代中迭代求解局部非线性问题和线性变分问题。虽然现有的非线性求解器用于解决非线性问题，但我们提出了一种与深度Ritz神经网络方法的新颖耦合，该方法非常适合线性变分问题的变分特性。为了在不牺牲精度的情况下提高算法效率，引入了用于选择配置点的自适应采样策略。本文展示了求解几个全非线性方程（从典型的Monge-Ampère方程开始）的Dirichlet问题的数值实验，显示了该方法的灵活性。将数值结果与使用完整PINNs方法获得的结果进行了比较。最后，数值实验扩展到解决具有传输边界条件的最佳传输Monge-Ampère问题。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种自适应深度Ritz框架，作为物理信息神经网络（PINNs）的替代方案，用于解决二阶全非线性偏微分方程。该方法利用最小二乘算法解耦非线性，并通过分裂方法迭代求解局部非线性问题和线性变分问题。它将深度Ritz神经网络与线性变分问题独特地结合起来，并采用自适应采样策略来提高效率。数值实验证明了其在解决Monge-Ampère方程等问题上的灵活性和性能，并与PINNs进行了比较，还扩展到最优传输问题。
AI.keywords: 深度Ritz框架, 全非线性偏微分方程, 自适应采样, 最小二乘算法, Monge-Ampère方程
AI.comments: 该论文通过利用深度Ritz框架，为PINNs提供了一种创新的替代方案，解决了全非线性偏微分方程的挑战。最小二乘算法、分裂方法和自适应采样策略的结合有助于提高准确性和效率。其在处理各种全非线性方程（包括最优传输问题）方面的灵活性突出了其潜力。与PINNs的比较提供了有用的基准。

title: Mind the Gap: Structure-Aware Consistency in Preference Learning
summary: Preference learning has become the foundation of aligning Large Language Models (LLMs) with human intent. Popular methods, such as Direct Preference Optimization (DPO), minimize surrogate losses as proxies for the intractable pairwise ranking loss. However, we demonstrate that for the equicontinuous hypothesis sets typical of neural networks, these standard surrogates are theoretically inconsistent, yielding vacuous generalization guarantees. To resolve this, we formulate LLM alignment within a margin-shifted ranking framework. We derive rigorous $H$-consistency bounds that depend on enforcing a separation margin $γ$. Crucially, we extend this to Structure-Aware $H$-consistency, introducing a novel objective (SA-DPO) that adapts the margin based on the semantic distance between responses to handle synonyms and hard pairs. Finally, we analyze the trade-off between consistency and model limitations via the Margin-Capacity Profile, proving that heavy-tailed surrogates (such as the Polynomial Hinge family) offer superior consistency guarantees for capacity-bounded models compared to the standard logistic loss used in DPO.

AI.title_translation: 注意差距：偏好学习中的结构感知一致性
AI.tldr: 标准偏好学习方法存在理论缺陷，作者提出了结构感知一致性框架，通过引入边距和自适应边距来提高LLM与人类意图的对齐效果，并分析了边距-容量关系。
AI.motivation: 标准的偏好学习方法（如DPO）在理论上存在不一致性，导致泛化保证空洞。
AI.method: 提出基于边距转移的排序框架，推导出H-一致性界限，并扩展到结构感知H-一致性，引入新的目标函数SA-DPO，根据语义距离自适应调整边距。分析了边距-容量剖面图，比较了不同代理损失函数的理论保证。
AI.result: 证明了标准代理损失函数理论上的不一致性；提出了SA-DPO，能够根据语义距离自适应调整边距；证明了重尾代理损失函数（如多项式铰链族）相比于DPO中使用的标准逻辑损失，为容量受限模型提供了更优的一致性保证。
AI.conclusion: 通过引入结构感知一致性框架和SA-DPO目标函数，可以更有效地将LLM与人类意图对齐，并且重尾代理损失函数在容量受限模型下具有更优的一致性保证。
AI.translation: 偏好学习已成为将大型语言模型（LLM）与人类意图对齐的基础。流行的方​​法，例如直接偏好优化（DPO），最小化了作为难解的成对排名损失代理的代理损失。然而，我们证明，对于通常由神经网络组成的等连续假设集，这些标准的代理在理论上是不一致的，导致泛化保证空洞。为了解决这个问题，我们在边距转移的排序框架内构建了LLM对齐。我们推导出了严格的H-一致性界限，这些界限取决于强制执行边距γ。关键是，我们将此扩展到结构感知H-一致性，引入了一种新颖的目标（SA-DPO），该目标根据语义距离来调整边距，以处理同义词和难对。最后，我们通过边距-容量剖面图分析了一致性与模型限制之间的权衡，证明了重尾代理（例如多项式铰链族）与DPO中使用的标准逻辑损失相比，为容量受限模型提供了更优的一致性保证。
AI.summary: 本研究指出了现有偏好学习方法（如DPO）在理论上存在不一致性问题，并提出了一个名为“结构感知一致性”的新框架。该框架通过引入边距概念和一种名为SA-DPO的新型目标函数，能够根据响应之间的语义距离自适应地调整边距，从而更好地处理同义词和难对，有效提升LLM与人类意图的对齐效果。此外，研究还表明重尾代理损失函数比标准逻辑损失函数为容量受限模型提供更好的理论保证。
AI.keywords: 偏好学习,LLM对齐,结构感知一致性,SA-DPO,边距学习
AI.comments: 该研究在理论上揭示了现有偏好学习方法的局限性，并提出了一个创新的结构感知一致性框架。SA-DPO的引入以及对边距-容量关系的分析，为提高LLM对齐效果提供了新的思路和理论支持。然而，该方法在实际应用中的计算成本和效果仍需进一步验证。

title: h-Adaptive FV Subcell Shock-Capturing for DGSEM on Heterogeneous Curvilinear Meshes
summary: High-order methods offer superior dispersion and dissipation properties compared to low-order schemes but require robust stabilization for discontinuities. To ensure stability, local artificial viscosity is common, but often degrades sub-element resolution. Conversely, subcell resolution preserving limiting strategies such as the finite volume subcell method are typically restricted to uniform topologies, such as purely hexahedral, or simplex meshes. This leaves a significant gap in treating the hybrid-element topologies necessary for complex engineering geometries. This paper presents a robust shock-capturing approach for the discontinuous Galerkin spectral element method on mixed curvilinear meshes containing hexahedral, prismatic, tetrahedral, and pyramid elements. Non-hexahedral elements are handled via collapsed coordinate transformations. The proposed method utilizes an h-adaptive finite volume subcell scheme with arbitrary subcell resolution; 2N + 1 in this work. The schemes essential properties, including conservation, spatial convergence, and the shock capturing capabilities are verified. Finally, the method's applicability to complex configurations is demonstrated through a simulation of the flow around a NACA 0012 airfoil.

AI.title_translation: 高阶有限体积子单元激波捕捉在非结构化曲网格上的DGSEM应用
AI.tldr: 该研究提出了一种用于处理复杂几何形状的混合网格的高阶激波捕捉方法，结合了h自适应有限体积子单元方法和间断伽辽金谱元方法。
AI.motivation: 现有的高阶方法在处理复杂几何形状和混合网格时，在激波捕捉和子单元分辨率方面存在不足。
AI.method: 提出了一种基于h自适应有限体积子单元（2N+1分辨率）的激波捕捉方法，并将其应用于间断伽辽金谱元方法，以处理包含各种单元类型的混合曲网格，非六面体单元通过坐标变换处理。
AI.result: 验证了该方法的守恒性、空间收敛性和激波捕捉能力，并通过NACA 0012翼型绕流模拟展示了其在复杂几何形状上的应用。
AI.conclusion: 该方法成功地实现了在混合曲网格上的高阶激波捕捉，解决了现有方法的局限性，并展示了其在工程应用中的潜力。
AI.translation: 高阶方法相比低阶格式具有优越的色散和耗散特性，但需要对间断进行鲁棒的稳定化处理。为了确保稳定性，局部人工粘性是常用的方法，但它通常会降低子单元分辨率。相反，能够保持子单元分辨率的限制策略，如有限体积子单元方法，通常局限于均匀拓扑，例如纯六面体或单形网格。这使得处理复杂工程几何形状所必需的混合单元拓扑存在显著的差距。本文提出了一种用于间断伽辽金谱元方法（DGSEM）在混合曲网格上的鲁棒激波捕捉方法，该网格包含六面体、棱柱体、四面体和棱锥体单元。非六面体单元通过折叠坐标变换进行处理。所提出的方法利用了具有任意子单元分辨率（本工作中为2N+1）的h自适应有限体积子单元方案。验证了该方案的基本属性，包括守恒性、空间收敛性和激波捕捉能力。最后，通过NACA 0012翼型绕流模拟展示了该方法在复杂配置上的适用性。
AI.summary: 本研究提出了一种用于间断伽辽金谱元方法（DGSEM）在混合曲网格上的h自适应有限体积子单元激波捕捉方法。该方法能够处理包含六面体、棱柱体、四面体和棱锥体等多种单元类型的复杂几何形状，并通过坐标变换处理非六面体单元。通过验证守恒性、收敛性和激波捕捉能力，并成功模拟了NACA 0012翼型绕流，证明了该方法的有效性和鲁棒性。
AI.keywords: 激波捕捉, 间断伽辽金谱元方法, 有限体积子单元, 混合网格, h自适应
AI.comments: 该研究提出了一种新颖的激波捕捉方法，有效地解决了在复杂混合网格上进行高阶计算的挑战。通过结合h自适应有限体积子单元技术和DGSEM，该方法在保持高精度和鲁棒性的同时，能够处理非结构化和非均匀的网格拓扑，这对于实际工程应用具有重要意义。然而，计算成本和在大规模复杂问题上的可扩展性可能需要进一步研究。

title: Differential Subgroup Discovery: Characterizing Where Two Populations Differ, and Why
summary: We study the problem of understanding where two populations differ within a feature space, which we formalize in the concept of a differential subgroup: a subset of individuals from both populations who, despite sharing similar characteristics, exhibit exceptional differences in a target outcome. Differential subgroups reveal the regions of the feature space where population-level gaps are most pronounced and can help practitioners identify the covariate combinations that are structurally responsible for these differences, e.g.~in clinical analysis, model diagnostics, or treatment-effect studies. We introduce a general optimization objective for discovering differential subgroups and establish conditions under which the resulting subgroups admit a causal interpretation of population differences. We propose DiffSub, a gradient-based approach that discovers interpretable differential subgroups in tabular data. Across synthetic benchmarks, medical case studies, model-error analyses, and treatment-effect settings, DiffSub identifies informative subgroups that reveal where population differences arise and why.

AI.title_translation: 差异子群发现：刻画两个群体在何处不同，以及为何不同
AI.tldr: 该研究提出了一种名为DiffSub的梯度下降方法，用于在表格数据中发现有意义的差异子群，解释了不同群体在哪些区域存在显著差异以及造成这些差异的原因。
AI.motivation: 理解两个群体在特征空间中的差异所在，识别导致这些差异的协变量组合，例如在临床分析、模型诊断或治疗效果研究中。
AI.method: 提出一个通用的优化目标来发现差异子群，并提出了一种名为DiffSub的梯度下降方法来发现可解释的差异子群，适用于表格数据。
AI.result: DiffSub在合成基准、医学案例研究、模型误差分析和治疗效果设置中，成功识别出信息丰富的子群，揭示了群体差异的来源和原因。
AI.conclusion: DiffSub能够发现可解释的差异子群，揭示了群体差异的来源和原因，并具备因果推断的潜力。
AI.translation: 我们研究了理解两个群体在特征空间中的差异所在的问题，我们将其形式化为差异子群的概念：来自两个群体的个体子集，尽管具有相似的特征，但在目标结果上却表现出异常的差异。差异子群揭示了特征空间中群体差距最显著的区域，并有助于从业者识别在结构上造成这些差异的协变量组合，例如在临床分析、模型诊断或治疗效果研究中。我们提出了一个通用的优化目标来发现差异子群，并建立了所得子群具有群体差异因果解释的条件。我们提出DiffSub，一种基于梯度的方​​法，可在表格数据中发现可解释的差异子群。在合成基准、医学案例研究、模型误差分析和治疗效果设置中，DiffSub识别出信息丰富的子群，揭示了群体差异的来源和原因。
AI.summary: 本研究提出了一种发现差异子群（即在特征空间中表现出显著差异的群体子集）的新方法DiffSub。DiffSub采用梯度下降技术处理表格数据，旨在识别出造成群体差异的关键区域和协变量组合。研究表明，DiffSub在多种应用场景下均能有效识别出有意义的子群，为理解和解释群体差异提供了有力工具，并具备一定的因果推断能力。
AI.keywords: 差异子群, 特征空间, 梯度下降, 可解释性, 协变量
AI.comments: 该研究提出的DiffSub方法在差异子群发现方面具有创新性，特别是在结合可解释性和梯度下降方法方面。该方法在多个真实世界场景中的应用潜力巨大，尤其是在需要深入理解群体差异的领域。然而，关于该方法在处理高维稀疏数据或非表格数据时的扩展性和鲁棒性仍需进一步研究。

title: Linear-Core Surrogates: Smooth Loss Functions with Linear Rates for Classification and Structured Prediction
summary: The choice of loss function in classification involves a fundamental trade-off: smooth losses (like Cross-Entropy) enable fast optimization rates but yield slow square-root consistency bounds, while piecewise-linear losses (like Hinge) offer fast linear consistency rates but suffer from non-differentiability. We propose Linear-Core (LC) Surrogates, a new family of convex loss functions that resolve this tension by stitching a linear core to a smooth tail. We prove that these surrogates are differentiable everywhere while retaining strict linear $H$-consistency bounds, effectively combining the optimization benefits of smoothness with the statistical efficiency of margin-based losses. In the structured prediction setting, we show that this smoothness unlocks a massive computational and energy advantage: it allows for an unbiased stochastic gradient estimator that bypasses the quadratic complexity $O(|\mathscr{Y}|^2)$ of exact inference (e.g., Viterbi). Empirically, our method achieves a 23$\times$ speedup over Structured SVMs on large-vocabulary sequence tagging tasks and demonstrates superior robustness to instance-dependent label noise, outperforming Cross-Entropy by 2.6% on corrupted CIFAR-10.

AI.title_translation: 线性核心代理：用于分类和结构化预测的具有线性速率的光滑损失函数
AI.tldr: 提出了一种名为线性核心（LC）代理的新型损失函数，它结合了光滑损失（如交叉熵）的优化优势和基于边际损失的线性一致性速率，同时解决了它们的缺点。
AI.motivation: 分类任务中的损失函数选择存在平滑损失（如交叉熵）优化速率快但一致性界限慢，以及分段线性损失（如合页损失）一致性速率快但不可微的权衡问题。
AI.method: 提出并分析了一种名为线性核心（LC）代理的新型凸损失函数族，该函数族通过将线性核心与光滑尾部缝合在一起，从而在保持严格线性H一致性界限的同时实现处处可微。
AI.result: LC代理在结构化预测中实现了无偏随机梯度估计，避免了精确推理的二次复杂度。在实际应用中，与结构化SVM相比，LC代理在大型词汇量序列标注任务上实现了23倍的加速，并且在CIFAR-10数据集的带噪声样本上，比交叉熵提高了2.6%的准确率。
AI.conclusion: LC代理通过结合光滑损失的优化优势和基于边际损失的统计效率，成功解决了损失函数选择中的权衡问题，并在结构化预测和实际应用中展现出显著的计算和统计优势。
AI.translation: 分类中的损失函数选择涉及一个基本权衡：光滑损失（如交叉熵）可实现快速优化速率，但会产生缓慢的平方根一致性界限；而分段线性损失（如合页损失）提供快速线性一致性速率，但存在不可微性问题。我们提出了线性核心（LC）代理，一种新的凸损失函数族，通过将线性核心与光滑尾部缝合在一起，解决了这种矛盾。我们证明了这些代理在处处可微的同时，保留了严格的线性H一致性界限，有效地结合了光滑性的优化优势和基于边际损失的统计效率。在结构化预测设置中，我们表明这种光滑性带来了巨大的计算和能源优势：它允许使用无偏随机梯度估计器，从而避免了精确推理（例如Viterbi）的二次复杂度O(|Y|^2)。在实践中，我们的方法在大型词汇量序列标注任务上实现了比结构化SVM快23倍的速度，并表现出对实例相关标签噪声的优越鲁棒性，在损坏的CIFAR-10数据集上比交叉熵提高了2.6%。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种名为线性核心（LC）代理的新型凸损失函数，该函数通过结合光滑损失和线性损失的优点，解决了分类和结构化预测中的损失函数选择难题。LC代理在保持处处可微的同时，实现了快速优化和线性一致性界限，并在结构化预测中通过无偏随机梯度估计器显著降低了计算复杂度。实验结果表明，LC代理在序列标注任务和带噪声数据上均表现出色。
AI.keywords: 线性核心代理,光滑损失函数,结构化预测,线性一致性,随机梯度估计
AI.comments: 该研究提出的线性核心（LC）代理是一种创新的损失函数，它巧妙地结合了光滑损失和分段线性损失的优点，解决了长期存在的优化速度与统计效率之间的权衡问题。其在结构化预测中实现的计算和能源优势尤其引人注目，为处理大规模和复杂预测任务提供了新的解决方案。然而，该方法在实际应用中的可扩展性和对不同类型噪声的鲁棒性仍需进一步探索。

title: Why Self-Supervised Encoders Want to Be Normal
summary:
We develop a geometric and information-theoretic framework for encoder-decoder learning built on the Information Bottleneck (IB) principle. Recasting IB as a rate-distortion problem with Kullback-Leibler (KL) divergence as distortion, we show that the optimal representation at any distortion level is a soft clustering of the \emph{predictive manifold} $\mathcal{M}=\{p(Y|x):x\in\mathcal{X}\}$ inside the probability simplex, admitting a linear decoder in the canonical parameterization.
  We derive a chain of exact transformations, from flat Dirichlet to exponential to isotropic Gaussian, connecting the maximum entropy prior on the simplex to Euclidean space, with quantified entropy overhead at each step, and show that Sketched Isotropic Gaussian Regularization (SIGReg) implements a Gaussian relaxation of this principle whose overhead affects rate accounting but not achievable prediction. This relaxation provides a principled distributional regularizer for learning with limited or no supervision.
  Using the Conditional Entropy Bottleneck (CEB) decomposition, we derive concrete encoder losses for supervised and semi-supervised settings, estimated via minibatch marginals without variational bounds. In the self-supervised setting, the CEB conditional rate is replaced by a view-prediction proxy. SIGReg serves as the distributional regularizer for both the semi-supervised and self-supervised settings.
  Experiments on toy problems and FashionMNIST confirm the predicted rate-distortion trade-offs and show that the non-parametric estimator is competitive with the standard variational approach.

AI.title_translation: 为什么自监督编码器倾向于“正态化”
AI.tldr: 该论文从几何与信息论角度揭示了自监督编码器偏好高斯表示的原因，并提出了一种基于高斯正则化且无需变分界限的有效学习框架。
AI.motivation: 旨在解释为什么自监督学习中的编码器倾向于学习到正态分布表示，并试图为表示学习提供一个统一的几何和信息论框架。
AI.method: 基于信息瓶颈（IB）原则，将问题重构为以KL散度为失真的率失真问题；推导了从Dirichlet分布到各向同性高斯分布的几何变换链；提出了Sketched Isotropic Gaussian Regularization (SIGReg) 作为分布式正则化器；利用条件熵瓶颈（CEB）分解，通过小批量边际分布直接估计编码器损失。
AI.result: 在玩具问题和FashionMNIST上的实验证实了理论预测的率失真权衡，且证明了所提出的非参数化估计器在性能上可与标准的变分方法相媲美。
AI.conclusion: 该研究成功地将自监督学习中的编码器行为与信息瓶颈原则联系起来，证明了高斯正则化在表示学习中的几何合理性，并提出了一种无需变分界限的非参数化估计方法。
AI.translation: 我们建立了一个基于信息瓶颈（IB）原则的编码器-解码器学习几何与信息论框架。通过将IB重构为以Kullback-Leibler（KL）散度作为失真的率失真问题，我们证明了在任何失真水平下的最优表示都是概率单纯形内“预测流形”$\mathcal{M}=\{p(Y|x):x\in\mathcal{X}\}$的软聚类，并在规范参数化下允许线性解码器。我们推导了一系列精确变换，从平坦Dirichlet分布到指数分布再到各向同性高斯分布，连接了单纯形上的最大熵先验与欧几里得空间，并量化了每一步的熵开销。我们证明了“草图各向同性高斯正则化”（SIGReg）实现了该原则的高斯松弛，其开销影响速率计算但不影响可达到的预测性能。这种松弛为有限监督或无监督学习提供了一个原则性的分布正则化器。利用条件熵瓶颈（CEB）分解，我们导出了监督和半监督设置下的具体编码器损失，并通过小批量边际分布进行估计，无需变分界限。在自监督设置中，CEB条件速率被视图预测代理所取代。SIGReg在半监督和自监督设置中均作为分布式正则化器。在玩具问题和FashionMNIST上的实验证实了所预测的率失真权衡，并表明该非参数估计器与标准变分方法具有竞争力。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种基于信息瓶颈原则的几何框架，解释了自监督编码器为何偏好高斯表示。通过将IB重构为率失真问题，作者推导了从概率单纯形到欧几里得空间的映射，并引入了SIGReg正则化方法，实现了一种无需变分界限的直接损失估计，为监督、半监督及自监督学习提供了理论支撑。
AI.keywords: 自监督学习, 信息瓶颈, 率失真, 高斯正则化, 表示学习
AI.comments: 该论文通过几何和信息论视角，为自监督学习中编码器偏好“正态分布”提供了理论解释。其创新点在于将信息瓶颈（IB）重构为率失真问题，并推导出了从单纯形到欧几里得空间的分布映射，为理解表示学习提供了深刻的几何洞察。该方法的局限性在于其理论推导较为复杂，且目前的实验主要基于玩具数据集和FashionMNIST，在大规模真实数据集上的扩展性有待进一步验证。

title: Consumer Attitudes Towards AI in Digital Health: A Mixed-Methods Survey in Australia
summary: AI applications are increasingly being introduced into digital health. While technical performance has advanced rapidly, successful deployment mainly depends on consumer attitudes, especially to patient-facing applications. However, most existing research examines consumer attitudes towards healthcare AI at an abstract level rather than in response to concrete artefacts. We report a mixed-methods survey study in Australia (N=275) examining consumer readiness, acceptance, trust, and risk perceptions of healthcare AI, combined with a scenario-based evaluation of an AI-generated versus clinician-written consultation summary. Participants expressed moderate optimism and strong perceived usefulness and ease of use, but also substantial concerns about accuracy, safety, and data use. In the scenario task, the AI-generated summary was strongly preferred for quality, empathy, and overall usefulness, yet identification of the AI summary was near chance. Findings show that consumers judge AI through concrete communication quality and visible human governance, underscoring the need for clinically supervised deployment frameworks beyond technical performance alone.

title: Average-Tree Phylogenetic Diversity Parameterized by Scanwidth and Invisibility
summary: We investigate parameterized algorithms for computing the average-tree phylogenetic diversity (APD) in rooted phylogenetic networks, studying the problem under different structural parameters that capture the deviation of a network from a tree. Our primary parameter is the scanwidth, a measure of the tree-likeness of a given directed acyclic graph. We show that a subset of taxa with maximum APD can be found in polynomial time in phylogenetic networks of scanwidth at most 2, but becomes NP-hard in networks of scanwidth 3. Further, we design an algorithm that computes the APD of a given set of taxa in O(2^sw n) time, where sw denotes the scanwidth and n the number of taxa in the input network. Finally, we give a linear-time algorithm for computing the APD of a given set of taxa if the network induced by these taxa is reticulation-visible. We generalize this algorithm to still run in polynomial time if each biconnected component of the induced network has only constantly many invisible reticulations.

title: Position-Aware Drafting for Inference Acceleration in LLM-Based Generative List-Wise Recommendation
summary: Large language model (LLM)-based generative list-wise recommendation has advanced rapidly, but decoding remains sequential and thus latency-prone. To accelerate inference without changing the target distribution, speculative decoding (SD) uses a small draft model to propose several next tokens at once and a target LLM to verify and accept the longest prefix, skipping multiple steps per round. In generative recommendation, however, each item is represented by multiple semantic-ID tokens, often with separators, and current drafts typically treat these tokens uniformly. This overlooks two practical facts: (i) a token's semantics depend on its within-item slot, and (ii) uncertainty tends to increase with speculation depth. Without modeling these effects, SD's speedups can be limited. We introduce PAD-Rec, Position-Aware Drafting for generative Recommendation, a lightweight module that augments the draft model with two complementary signals. Item position embeddings explicitly encode the within-item slot of each token, strengthening structural awareness. Step position embeddings encode the draft step, allowing the model to adapt to depth-dependent uncertainty and improve proposal quality. To harmonize these signals with base features, we add simple gates: a learnable coefficient for item slots and a context-driven gate for draft steps. The module is trainable, easy to integrate with standard draft models, and adds negligible inference overhead. Extensive experiments on four real-world datasets show up to 3.1x wall-clock speedup and about 5% average wall-clock speedup gain over strong SD baselines, while largely preserving recommendation quality.

title: Autonomous Traffic Signal Optimization Using Digital Twin and Agentic AI for Real-Time Decision-Making
comments: This paper is submitted to MECON2026 conference
summary: This article outlines a new framework of traffic light optimization through a digital twin of the transport infrastructure, managed by agentic AI to ensure real-time autonomous decisions. The framework relies on physical sensors and edge computing to measure real-time traffic information and simulate traffic flow in a constantly updated digital twin. The traffic light is automatically controlled through the digital twin according to traffic congestion, travel delay and traffic patterns. This approach is implemented as a three-layer system: perception, conceptualization and action. The perception layer receives data on physical systems; the conceptualization layer uses LangChain to process the data; and the action layer links to the Model Context Protocol (MCP) and traffic management APIs to implement optimised traffic signal control algorithms. The results show that the framework minimizes waiting time at traffic lights and positively affects the effectiveness of the entire traffic flow, which is better than the fixed-time and reinforcement learning-based baselines.
comment: This paper is submitted to MECON2026 conference

title: Multifaceted Hero Developers and Bug-Fixing Outcomes Across Severity
summary: Open-source projects often rely on a small group of highly active contributors known as hero developers. Prior work shows that hero developers are common in many OSS and enterprise projects, yet who qualifies as a hero depends heavily on the chosen contribution metric. Code-based metrics identify implementation-focused developers, whereas discussion-based metrics highlight coordination and communication; these metrics capture distinct facets of contribution. We conducted a measurement-sensitive study of multifaceted heroism across 77 Apache Software Foundation projects using three technical measures (commit count, distinct files touched, churn) and two social measures (issue-comment count, number of distinct issues commented on). We examined hero prevalence, overlap among hero sets, and severity-wise bug-fixing outcomes via fix and reopen rates. Results show that hero projects are common under all measures, but identified heroes differ substantially across facets. The pooled Jaccard overlap between technical and social hero sets is only 0.10. Cross-facet asymmetry is evident: 71.4% of technical heroes exhibit strong social activity, while only 24.2% of social heroes show strong technical activity. Fix-rate and reopen-rate differences are modest, yet hero-category rankings vary across severity levels and outcome measures. These findings indicate that heroism is not a single, metric-independent role. A multifaceted perspective offers a more reliable understanding of key contributors and better supports developer prioritisation and severity-aware bug assignment.

title: Temporal Routing in Static Networks: The Schedule Completion Problem
summary: We introduce the TemporallyEdgeDisjointScheduleCompletion (TEDSC) problem in which we need to cover a set of temporal edge demands $D$ by routing $k$ temporal walks through a directed static graph while remaining temporally edge disjoint. This problem combines the temporal aspects of train routing and passenger demands with the static nature of real-world rail networks. We present a polynomial time algorithm for TEDSC. Motivated by real world constraints, we next investigate two restricted variants of TEDSC in which each walk can only travel for some bounded distance or time $h$. We show that both are tractable when parameterized by $k + h$, but hard for $h$ and $k + |D|$. If we fix the underlying network, the two problems exhibit distinct complexities: The distance variant remains $W[1]$-hard parameterized by $k$ even on a path of three vertices whereas the time variant admits an FPT algorithm on any fixed star. Finally, we show how to approximate the number of required walks up to a factor of $(2-h^{-1})$.

AI.title_translation: 静态网络中的时间路由：调度完成问题
AI.tldr: 本文引入了时间边不相交调度完成（TEDSC）问题，该问题结合了时间路由和静态网络的特性。文章提出了TEDSC的多项式时间算法，并深入分析了其两个受限变体的参数化复杂性，最后提供了一种近似算法。
AI.motivation: 该研究的动机是将列车路由和乘客需求的时间特性与现实世界铁路网络的静态特性相结合，以解决调度完成问题。
AI.method: 本文引入了时间边不相交调度完成（TEDSC）问题。提出了TEDSC的多项式时间算法。研究了两个受限变体（行程距离或时间受限），并分析了它们的参数化复杂性。在固定网络上，分析了两种变体的不同复杂性。给出了所需行程数量的近似算法。
AI.result: 1. 为TEDSC问题提出了一个多项式时间算法。2. 两个受限变体（距离或时间有界）在参数化为 $k+h$ 时是易处理的，但在参数化为 $h$ 和 $k+|D|$ 时是困难的。3. 在固定网络上，距离变体即使在三顶点路径上，以 $k$ 为参数时仍然是 $W[1]$-hard，而时间变体在任何固定星形图上都承认FPT算法。4. 可以将所需行程的数量近似到 $(2-h^{-1})$ 的因子。
AI.conclusion: 论文引入了TEDSC问题及其变体，并针对这些问题提供了多项式时间算法、参数化复杂性分析以及近似算法，揭示了在不同约束和网络结构下问题的可解性。
AI.translation: 我们引入了时间边不相交调度完成（TEDSC）问题，在该问题中，我们需要通过在有向静态图中路由 $k$ 条时间路径来覆盖一组时间边需求 $D$，同时保持时间边不相交。这个问题结合了列车路由和乘客需求的时间特性与现实世界铁路网络的静态特性。我们提出了一个用于TEDSC的多项式时间算法。受现实世界约束的启发，我们接下来研究了TEDSC的两个受限变体，其中每条路径只能在某个有界距离或时间 $h$ 内行进。我们表明，当以 $k+h$ 为参数时，两者都是易处理的，但当以 $h$ 和 $k+|D|$ 为参数时是困难的。如果我们固定底层网络，这两个问题表现出不同的复杂性：距离变体即使在只有三个顶点的路径上，以 $k$ 为参数时仍然是 $W[1]$-hard，而时间变体在任何固定星形图上都承认FPT算法。最后，我们展示了如何将所需路径的数量近似到 $(2-h^{-1})$ 的因子。
AI.summary: 本文引入了时间边不相交调度完成（TEDSC）问题，旨在通过在静态图中路由时间路径来满足时间边需求，同时保持路径不相交。该问题结合了列车调度的时间性和铁路网络的静态性。文章提出了TEDSC的多项式时间算法，并深入探讨了受距离或时间限制的两种变体的复杂性，包括其参数化易处理性和困难性。此外，论文还分析了在固定网络上两种变体的不同计算复杂性，并提供了一种近似所需路径数量的方法。
AI.keywords: 时间路由, 静态网络, 调度完成问题, 参数化复杂性, 近似算法
AI.comments: 这篇论文通过引入TEDSC问题及其在现实世界铁路网络中的应用，为时间路由领域做出了贡献。它不仅提出了一个基本问题的多项式时间解决方案，还深入探讨了在实际约束下（如行程距离或时间限制）问题的复杂性，包括参数化复杂性分析和近似算法。特别是在固定网络上对两种变体复杂度的区分分析，揭示了问题在不同约束条件下的内在困难性，具有重要的理论和实践意义。

title: Möbius-transformed trapezoidal rule for polynomial weights
summary: This work studies numerical integration by the Möbius-transformed trapezoidal rule, which combines the classical trapezoidal rule with a change of variables induced by a Möbius transformation that maps the unit circle onto the real line. It is shown that this method achieves the optimal convergence rate for a polynomially weighted integral over the real line if the integrand lives in a related polynomially weighted Sobolev space with positive integer smoothness index. This result can also be generalized in a slightly weaker form for fractional smoothness indices via complex interpolation of function spaces. The algorithm only requires pointwise evaluations of the weight and the target integrand at prescribed nodes that do not depend on the integrand and weight in question. The established theoretical convergence rates are verified by numerical experiments.

AI.title_translation: Möbius 变换的梯形法则用于多项式权重
AI.tldr: 该工作研究了Möbius变换的梯形法则在多项式加权积分中的应用，证明了其在特定函数空间下可达到最优收敛速度。
AI.motivation: 研究一种结合Möbius变换的梯形法则，用于数值积分，特别是在实线上处理多项式加权积分问题。
AI.method: 该方法结合了经典的梯形法则和Möbius变换（将单位圆映射到实线）。通过函数空间的复插值推广结果。算法仅需在不依赖于被积函数和权重的预定节点处进行逐点评估。
AI.result: 证明了该方法对于实线上多项式加权积分，当被积函数位于相关的多项式加权Sobolev空间且具有正整数光滑度指数时，可达到最优收敛速度。对于分数光滑度指数，结果以稍弱的形式通过函数空间的复插值得到推广。数值实验验证了理论收敛率。
AI.conclusion: Möbius变换的梯形法则在特定条件下，对于多项式加权积分能够实现最优收敛速度，并且其理论结果得到了数值验证。
AI.translation: 这项工作研究了Möbius变换的梯形法则进行数值积分，该法则将经典的梯形法则与由Möbius变换引起的变量变换相结合，Möbius变换将单位圆映射到实线。结果表明，如果被积函数位于相关的多项式加权Sobolev空间且具有正整数光滑度指数，则该方法对于实线上的多项式加权积分能够达到最优收敛速度。这一结果也可以通过函数空间的复插值以稍微弱的形式推广到分数光滑度指数。该算法只需要在不依赖于被积函数和权重的预定节点处对权重和目标被积函数进行逐点评估。建立的理论收敛率通过数值实验得到了验证。
AI.summary: 本文研究了结合Möbius变换的梯形法则在数值积分中的应用，该方法将单位圆映射到实线。研究表明，对于实线上的多项式加权积分，当被积函数在特定多项式加权Sobolev空间中时，该方法能够实现最优收敛速度。此结果通过复插值可推广至分数光滑度。该算法仅需在独立于被积函数和权重的节点处进行逐点评估，并且理论收敛率已通过数值实验验证。
AI.keywords: Möbius变换, 梯形法则, 数值积分, 多项式权重, 收敛速度
AI.comments: 这篇论文的创新点在于将Möbius变换引入经典的梯形法则，以高效处理实线上的多项式加权积分问题。其重要性在于证明了在特定函数空间下该方法的理论最优收敛速度，并提供了实际可行的算法。

title: Learning to Reason: Targeted Knowledge Discovery and Fuzzy Logic Update for Robust Image Recognition
summary: Integrating domain knowledge into deep neural networks is a promising way to improve generalization. Existing methods either encode prior knowledge in the loss function or apply post-processing modules, but both depend on identifying useful symbolic knowledge to integrate. Since such rules are often unavailable in real-world vision tasks, we propose a method for targeted knowledge discovery. We propose a Differentiable Knowledge Unit (DKU) that enables modulating the classifier logits, yielding refined class probabilities. The DKU uses implication rules to represent relationships between task classes and implicit concepts learned entirely from the main task supervision, without requiring concept labels. Concepts are identified by dedicated classifiers, whose probabilities are passed to DKU alongside the primary class probabilities. DKU computes a logic-based adjustment vector via fuzzy inference, which modulates the primary class logits to yield refined class probabilities. When concept classifiers represent concepts that do not support the logical rule structure, the resulting adjustments to the class probabilities do not directly minimize the supervision loss. Consequently, optimizing the supervision loss on these adjusted class probabilities implicitly trains the concept classifiers. We construct the rule base so that bidirectional logical relations connect concepts and classes. We enforce the concepts to be distinct from each other and with respect to the classes. This design enforces a clean supervision signal for concept learning. We evaluate our methods on the PASCAL-VOC, COCO, and MedMNIST datasets. We demonstrate improvement through our knowledge integration across these datasets. We conduct domain generalization and hard-sample ablation studies and find that our implicit knowledge discovery and integration outperforms the baseline.

AI.title_translation: 学习推理：针对性知识发现与模糊逻辑更新用于鲁棒图像识别
AI.tldr: 该研究提出了一种名为可微分知识单元（DKU）的新方法，用于在深度神经网络中自动发现和集成领域知识，以改进图像识别的泛化能力。该方法通过模糊推理和逻辑规则来调整分类器的输出，无需预先定义符号知识，并在多个数据集上验证了其有效性。
AI.motivation: 现有方法在整合领域知识到深度神经网络以提高泛化能力时，通常需要预先识别有用的符号知识，而这在现实世界的视觉任务中往往不可用。因此，本研究的动机是提出一种能够自动发现和集成领域知识的方法。
AI.method: 提出了一种可微分知识单元（DKU），它通过模糊推理和逻辑规则来调整分类器的logits，从而得到改进的类别概率。DKU利用蕴含规则表示类别与通过监督学习到的隐式概念之间的关系，无需概念标签。概念由专门的分类器识别，其概率与主要类别概率一起输入DKU。DKU计算一个基于模糊推理的逻辑调整向量，用于调整主要类别logits。通过优化调整后的类别概率的监督损失，可以隐式地训练概念分类器。研究人员还构建了一个规则库，使概念和类别之间存在双向逻辑关系，并强制概念彼此区分以及与类别区分，以提供清晰的概念学习监督信号。
AI.result: 在PASCAL-VOC、COCO和MedMNIST数据集上进行了评估，结果表明所提出的知识集成方法在这些数据集上均有所改进。通过进行领域泛化和困难样本消融研究，证明了该方法在隐式知识发现和集成方面优于基线方法。
AI.conclusion: 通过自动发现和集成领域知识，本研究成功地提高了图像识别模型的泛化能力和鲁棒性，尤其是在缺乏预定义符号知识的情况下。所提出的DKU方法提供了一种有效的方式来利用模糊逻辑和蕴含规则来增强深度学习模型。
AI.translation: 将领域知识集成到深度神经网络中是提高泛化能力的有前途的方法。现有方法要么在损失函数中编码先验知识，要么应用后处理模块，但两者都依赖于识别有用的符号知识来集成。由于在现实世界的视觉任务中通常无法获得此类规则，我们提出了一种针对性知识发现的方法。我们提出了一种可微分知识单元（DKU），它能够调节分类器的logits，从而产生改进的类别概率。DKU使用蕴含规则来表示任务类别与完全从主要任务监督中学到的隐式概念之间的关系，而无需概念标签。概念由专用的分类器识别，其概率与主要类别概率一起传递给DKU。DKU通过模糊推理计算基于逻辑的调整向量，该向量用于调节主要类别logits以产生改进的类别概率。当概念分类器表示不支持逻辑规则结构的概念时，对类别概率的调整不会直接最小化监督损失。因此，在这些调整后的类别概率上优化监督损失会隐式地训练概念分类器。我们构建了规则库，使双向逻辑关系连接概念和类别。我们强制概念彼此区分，并与类别区分。这种设计强制了清晰的监督信号用于概念学习。我们在PASCAL-VOC、COCO和MedMNIST数据集上评估了我们的方法。我们证明了在这些数据集上的知识集成带来的改进。我们进行了领域泛化和困难样本消融研究，发现我们的隐式知识发现和集成优于基线方法。
AI.summary: 本研究提出了一种名为可微分知识单元（DKU）的新方法，用于在深度神经网络中自动发现和集成领域知识，以改进图像识别的泛化能力。该方法通过模糊推理和逻辑规则来调整分类器的输出，无需预先定义符号知识，并在多个数据集上验证了其有效性。
AI.keywords: 知识发现, 深度学习, 图像识别, 模糊逻辑, 可微分知识单元（DKU）
AI.comments: 该研究提出了一种新颖的基于DKU的方法，用于在缺乏显式符号知识的情况下自动发现和集成领域知识，以提高图像识别的鲁棒性。通过模糊逻辑和蕴含规则进行知识集成是一个有前途的方向。然而，该方法在概念分类器和规则库的构建方面可能存在一定的复杂性，并且其在更广泛的领域和任务上的泛化能力仍需进一步验证。

title: Intent2Tx: Benchmarking LLMs for Translating Natural Language Intents into Ethereum Transactions
summary: The emergence of Large Language Models (LLMs) offers a transformative interface for Web3, yet existing benchmarks fail to capture the complexity of translating high-level user intents into functionally correct, state-dependent on-chain transactions. We present \textsc{Intent2Tx}, a high-fidelity benchmark featuring 29,921 single-step and 1,575 multi-step instances meticulously derived from 300 days of real-world Ethereum mainnet traces. Unlike prior works that rely on synthetic instructions, \textsc{Intent2Tx} grounds natural language intents in real-world protocol interactions across 11 categories, including diverse long-tail Decentralized Finance (DeFi) primitives. To enable rigorous evaluation, we propose an execution-aware framework that transcends surface-level text matching by employing differential state analysis on forked mainnet environments. Our extensive evaluation of 16 state-of-the-art LLMs reveals that while scaling and retrieval-augmentation enhance logical consistency and parameter precision, current models struggle with out-of-distribution generalization and multi-step planning. Crucially, our execution-based analysis demonstrates that syntactically valid outputs often fail to achieve intended state transitions, highlighting a significant gap in current "reasoning-to-execution" capabilities. \textsc{Intent2Tx} serves as a critical foundation for developing autonomous, reliable agents in intent-centric Web3 ecosystems. Code and data: https://anonymous.4open.science/r/Intent2Tx_Bench-97FF .

title: GourNet: A CNN-Based Model for Mango Leaf Disease Detection
summary: Mango cultivation is crucial in the agricultural sector, significantly contributing to economic development and food security. However, diseases affecting mango leaves can significantly reduce both the production and overall fruit grade. Detecting leaf diseases at an early stage with precision is key to effective disease prevention and sustaining crop productivity. In this paper, we introduce a "deep learning" model named "GourNet", which leverages "Convolutional Neural Networks" to identify infections in mango leaves. We utilize the "MangoLeafBD" (MBD) dataset to train and assess the effectiveness of the presented model. The MBD dataset contains seven disease classes and a Healthy class, making a total of eight classes. To enhance model performance, the images are preprocessed through steps like resizing, rescaling, and data augmentation prior to training. To properly evaluate the model, the dataset is separated into 80% for training, with the remaining 20% equally split between validation and testing. Our model uses only 683,656 total parameters and achieves a classification accuracy of 97%. This research's source code can be found at: https://github.com/ekramalam/GourNet-Repo.

title: Instruction-Guided Poetry Generation in Arabic and Its Dialects
summary: Poetry has long been a central art form for Arabic speakers, serving as a powerful medium of expression and cultural identity. While modern Arabic speakers continue to value poetry, existing research on Arabic poetry within Large Language Models (LLMs) has primarily focused on analysis tasks such as interpretation or metadata prediction, e.g., rhyme schemes and titles. In contrast, our work addresses the practical aspect of poetry creation in Arabic by introducing controllable generation capabilities to assist users in writing poetry. Specifically, we present a large-scale, carefully curated instruction-based dataset in Modern Standard Arabic (MSA) and various Arabic dialects. This dataset enables tasks such as writing, revising, and continuing poems based on predefined criteria, including style and rhyme, as well as performing poetry analysis. Our experiments show that fine-tuning LLMs on this dataset yields models that can effectively generate poetry that is aligned with user requirements, based on both automated metrics and human evaluation with native Arabic speakers. The data and the code are available at https://github.com/mbzuai-nlp/instructpoet-ar

title: Monadic Presburger Predicates have Robust Population Protocols
summary:
Population protocols are a model of distributed computation in which a collection of indistinguishable finite-state agents interact randomly in pairs to decide a predicate of their initial configuration. The agents decide by achieving a stable consensus on whether the predicate holds or not. It is known that population protocols can decide exactly the predicates expressible in Presburger arithmetic.
  Recently, Lossin et al. have introduced a notion of protocol robustness against adversarial crash failures. They show that all atomic Presburger predicates can be decided by robust protocols, and ask whether the same holds for every Presburger predicate. We make progress towards settling this question by proving that all predicates expressible in monadic Presburger arithmetic have robust protocols. In addition, we analyze the cost of robustness in terms of state complexity. We study the ratio between the number of states of the smallest robust protocol for a given predicate and the smallest protocol for it. We show that the cost of robustness is at least double exponential in the size of the predicate, and prove that the robust protocols by Lossin et al. for threshold predicates x >= k have optimal state complexity.

title: Optimal Functional Incentives for Control: The Linear-Quadratic Case with Bilinear Incentives
summary: We study the design of functional incentive mechanisms for dynamical systems, in which a leader designs a fixed incentive function to motivate a self-interested follower to actuate the system beneficially over an extended horizon, without real-time revision of the incentive. This stands in contrast to the adaptive paradigm, in which the incentive is itself a continuously updated control variable. We formalize the problem as a discrete-time bi-level optimal control problem and derive analytical results for the linear-quadratic case with bilinear incentives and a myopic follower. Specifically, we establish a necessary and sufficient stability condition for the induced closed-loop system, derive a closed-form expression for the gradient of the expected leader cost with respect to the incentive parameter matrix, and obtain a fully closed-form cost expression in the scalar setting. Based on the latter, explicit characterizations of the optimal incentive parameter are provided in two asymptotic regimes: the infinite-horizon limit and the limit of high follower cost. For long horizons, the optimal incentive is shown to become independent of the follower's private cost parameter, with direct implications for robust mechanism design under private information.

title: WindowsWorld: A Process-Centric Benchmark of Autonomous GUI Agents in Professional Cross-Application Environments
summary: While GUI agents have shown impressive capabilities in common computer-use tasks such as OSWorld, current benchmarks mainly focus on isolated and single-application tasks. This overlooks a critical real-world requirement of coordinating across multiple applications to accomplish complex profession-specific workflows. To bridge this gap, we present a computer-use benchmark in cross-application workflows, named WindowsWorld, designed to systematically assess GUI Agents on complex multi-step tasks that mirror real-world professional activities. Our methodology uses a multi-agent framework steered by 16 occupations to generate four difficulty-level tasks with intermediate inspection, which are then refined by human review and executed in a simulated environment. The resulting benchmark contains 181 tasks with an average of 5.0 sub-goals across 17 common desktop applications, of which 78% are inherently multi-application. Experimental results of leading large models and agents show that: 1) All computer-use agents perform poorly on multi-application tasks (< 21% success rate), far below the performance of simple single-app tasks; 2) They largely fail at tasks requiring conditional judgment and reasoning across $\geq$ 3 applications, stalling at early sub-goals; 3) Low execution efficiency, where tasks often fail despite far exceeding human step limits. Code, benchmark data, and evaluation resources are available at github.com/HITsz-TMG/WindowsWorld.

title: RuC: HDL-Agnostic Rule Completion Benchmark Generation
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) have rapidly improved in performance across code-related tasks, making their integration into Register Transfer Level (RTL) development increasingly attractive. Mimicking the behavior of inline code assistants, many benchmarks evaluate LLMs' capabilities in code completion, either assessing the generation of entire hardware modules or the completion of a single line within a module. However both of these approaches lack the ability to control the granularity of the code-completion sample size and the syntactic range of completions. To overcome these limitations, we present a framework for language-agnostic rule completion (RuC), a grammar-driven, rule-selectable benchmark generator that automatically produces RTL code-completion tasks from a set of input hardware description sources. RuC uses the target Hardware Description Language (HDL) grammar to mask syntactically defined code regions and prompts a model to regenerate them using the surrounding unmasked code as context, enabling a controlled and scalable evaluation of the domain-specific model's code-understanding capabilities, ranging from assignments to the reconstruction of entire logic blocks. We use RuC to generate two SystemVerilog rule-completion benchmarks from the Tiny Tapeout shuttle TT07 and the CVE2 RISC-V core to demonstrate RuC's applicability to a broad range of designs, and conduct a comparative study of the code completion capabilities of modern open-source LLMs across diverse settings. Results indicate that completion performance strongly depends on the model type, the grammatical structure of the masked region, and the prompting strategy. Specifically, the highest scores are obtained with Fill-in-the-Middle (FIM) prompting. These findings highlight the value of grammar-driven, arbitrarily granular benchmarks for meaningful evaluation of LLM capabilities in RTL development workflows.

title: The Grand Software Supply Chain of AI Systems
summary: AI systems rest on software with low integrity mechanisms, leaving AI systems exposed across every stage from data acquisition to final inference. This paper makes the AI supply chain a first-class object of analysis, decomposing it across four architectural layers: data acquisition, model training, model inference, and a cross-cutting substrate. Within these layers, we identify four structural gaps that traditional supply chain mechanisms do not address: verifiability, versioning, observability, and traceability.Current AI systems fall short on all of them: they carry undeclared behavioral couplings that no resolver enforces; they cannot be reverted back to known working assemblies; they degrade silently rather than surfacing breaking changes; and their lineage can hardly be approximated. To illustrate the scale of the software supply chain of AI, we measure a reference stack of 48 production-grade open-source projects, which declares 4,664 direct dependencies, resolves to 11,508 transitive packages, and totals roughly 392M lines of code.

title: On the Expressive Power of GNNs to Solve Linear SDPs
summary: Semidefinite programs (SDPs) are a powerful framework for convex optimization and for constructing strong relaxations of hard combinatorial problems. However, solving large SDPs can be computationally expensive, motivating the use of machine learning models as fast computational surrogates. Graph neural networks (GNNs) are a natural candidate in this setting due to their sparsity-awareness and ability to model variable-constraint interactions. In this work, we study what expressive power is sufficient to recover optimal SDP solutions. We first prove negative results showing that standard GNN architectures fail on recovering linear SDP solutions. We then identify a more expressive architecture that captures the key structure of SDPs and can, in particular, emulate the updates of a standard first-order solver. Empirically, on both synthetic and \textsc{SdpLib} benchmarks of various classes of SDPs, this more expressive architecture achieves consistently lower prediction error and objective gap than theoretically weaker baselines. Finally, using the learned high-quality predictions to warm-start the first-order solver yields practical speedups of up to 80%.

title: Toward a Characterization of Simulation Between Arithmetic Theories
summary:
We study when a sound arithmetic theory $\mathcal S{\supseteq}S^1_2$ with polynomial-time decidable axioms efficiently proves the bounded consistency statements $Con_{\mathcal S{+}φ}(n)$ for a true sentence $φ$. Equivalently, we ask when $\mathcal S$, viewed as a proof system, simulates $\mathcal S{+}φ$. The paper's two unconditional contributions constrain possible characterizations. First, for finitely axiomatized sequential $\mathcal S$, if $EA{\vdash}Con_{\mathcal S}{\rightarrow}Con_{\mathcal S{+}φ}$, then $\mathcal S$ interprets $\mathcal S{+}φ$, implying ${\mathcal S}{\vdash^{n^{O(1)}}}Con_{\mathcal S}(p(n)){\rightarrow}Con_{\mathcal S{+}φ}(n)$ for some polynomial $p$, and hence ${\mathcal S}{\vdash^{n^{O(1)}}}Con_{\mathcal S{+}φ}(n)$. Second, if $\mathcal S$ fails to simulate $\mathcal S{+}φ$ for some true $φ$, then for all sufficiently large $k$ it also fails for $φ_{BB}(k)$ asserting the exact value of the $k$-state Busy Beaver function. Informally, any argument showing that $\mathcal S$ fails to simulate some $\mathcal S{+}φ$ also yields unprovable $φ_{BB}(k)$ witnessing the same obstruction. These results suggest that relative consistency strength is a serious candidate for governing when simulation is possible, while leaving open whether it is the correct criterion.
  The paper's central conjectural proposal is that the above sufficient condition is also necessary: if $EA{\not\vdash}Con_{\mathcal S}{\rightarrow}Con_{\mathcal S{+}φ}$, then for every constant $c{>}0$, ${\mathcal S}{\not\vdash^{n^c}}Con_{\mathcal S{+}φ}(n)$. Under this proposal, hardness follows in canonical cases where $φ$ is $Con_{\mathcal S}$ or a Kolmogorov-randomness axiom. The latter yields further conjectural consequences and extensions.

title: Test Before You Deploy: Governing Updates in the LLM Supply Chain
comments: 4 pages, 1 figure, accepted to The 2nd International Workshop on Large Language Model Supply Chain Analysis (LLMSC2026) co-located with FSE 2026
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly used as core dependencies in software systems. However, the hosted LLM services evolve continuously through provider-side updates without explicit version changes. These silent updates can introduce behavioral drift, causing regressions in functionality, formatting, safety constraints, or other application-specific requirements. Existing approaches focus primarily on regression testing or versioning but do not provide deployer-side mechanisms for governing compatibility during opaque model evolution. This paper proposes a deployment-side governance framework based on three components: clearly defined rules for how the model is allowed to behave (production contracts), focused testing organized by deployment risk categories (risk-category-based testing suite), and release checkpoints that block updates unless they meet defined safety and performance standards (compatibility gates). Through exploratory validation across multiple LLM versions, we provide evidence that targeted testing in specific risk areas can uncover performance regressions that overall metrics miss. We also identify several open research challenges, including how to systematically build effective test suites, how to set reliable performance thresholds in non-deterministic systems, and how to detect and explain model drift when providers offer limited transparency. Overall, we frame LLM update management as a software supply chain governance problem and outline a research agenda for putting deployer-side compatibility controls into practice.
